data.name: 文字の中に文字!
data.description_full:
目指せ、究極の「文字マスター」！
『文字の中に文字！』は、洗練された和の美学と、文字を解体する楽しさが融合した、新感覚のカジュアル脳トレパズルゲームです！
ここでは、あなたが知っている「ひらがな」や「言葉」の常識を一度捨てなければなりません。極限の観察力と想像力を駆使して、一見シンプルに見える文字の筆跡から、線の隙間に隠された「別の文字」を見つけ出しましょう！

🎮 ゲーム特徴
🧠 常識を覆す、文字解体パズル
コアとなるのは、文字をパーツごとに分解して再構築する「字中文字」システム。一筆一振りの交差、絶妙なカーブの中に、全く別の文字が隠されています。一つの文字から、まさかあんな文字やこんな言葉が導き出されるなんて！？あなたの脳を徹底的に活性化させます。

📜 心が整う、洗練された和の美学
ゲーム画面は、温かみのある和紙の質感と、味わい深い毛筆のタッチでデザインされています。古き良き和モダンな視覚空間と、心地よいBGMに包まれながら、謎解きと同時に最上のリラックス（地頭のデトックス）を体験してください。

🏆 大ボリュームのステージ、満たされる達成感
気軽に始められる「初級」から、頭を抱えるような超難問「達人級」まで、飽きのこない豊富なステージをご用意。ステージをクリアするたびにコインを獲得し、あなただけの称号評価が解放されていきます。一歩ずつ、本物の「文字の王様」へ！

💡 困ったときも安心の「知恵のヒント」機能
どうしても隠れた文字が見つからない？そんな時も大丈夫！ゲーム内には実用的な「ヒント」機能を搭載。思考がハチ切れそうな時、あなたの盲点をそっと突いて、流れるようなプレイ体験をサポートします。

👥 こんな方にオススメ！
文字パズルや言葉遊び（クロスワード、ナンクロなど）が大好きな方。

通勤・通学、ちょっとしたスキマ時間に、心地よく脳を動かしたいビジネスパーソンや学生。

観察力を鍛え、大人の脳トレを楽しみながら、日本語の線の美しさを再発見したいすべての方。

一筆一画に驚きがあり、一字の中に新しい世界が広がる。
今すぐ『文字の中に文字！』をダウンロードして、文字の奥深さを探求する知的な冒険へ出かけましょう！
data.description_short: Deconstruct and reconstruct letters! Unexpected letters emerge one after another from a single letter!?

data.name: Rummy 500
data.description_full:
Discover the relaxing and strategic fun of Rummy 500!

🎯 Rummy 500 is a popular classic card game for players of all ages — from beginners and casual players to seniors and longtime card game fans. Enjoy classic Rummy 500 anytime on your phone or tablet, with standard Rummy 500 rules and scoring, smart AI opponents, and smooth offline gameplay.

Whether you are relaxing while watching TV, winding down before bed, passing the time, or training your brain with a rewarding challenge, this classic offline card game is always ready to play — no wifi or mobile data required.

New to Rummy 500? No problem! Clear tutorials help you learn Rummy 500 at your own pace, so you can relax, improve your skills, and enjoy every round with confidence.

🎮 How to Play Rummy 500:

The goal is simple: empty your hand before your opponents and be the first to reach 500 points!

Draw cards, build sets and runs, lay off cards onto existing melds, and make smart discards to stay ahead of your opponents. Use Jokers wisely to create more possibilities and plan each move carefully as you race to 500 points.

🃏 If you enjoy card games like Solitaire, Spades, Hearts, Gin Rummy, Canasta, or other classic card games, Rummy 500 will feel instantly familiar and endlessly satisfying.

✨ Key Features of Rummy 500:

Play Offline Anytime
- No internet required. Play Rummy 500 for free at home, during a commute, while traveling, or whenever you want a relaxing card game break. Open the game anytime and enjoy classic card fun at your own pace.

Progressive Difficulty
- Play against opponents that grow more challenging as you improve. Start with beginner-friendly rounds, then sharpen your strategy, memory, meld-building skills, and card play over time.

Large Cards & Smooth Gameplay
- Enjoy large, easy-to-read cards, a polished 3D card table, clear visuals, and smooth controls for a comfortable card game experience. Drawing, melding, laying off, and discarding cards feel clear, responsive, and easy to follow.

Helpful Tools for Easy Play
- Sort and rearrange your hand, use unlimited smart hints to find better moves, and enjoy unlimited undos when you want to fix a mistake. These helpful tools make it easier to form melds and avoid misplays.

Jokers Add More Strategy
- Use Jokers as wild cards to create more meld possibilities and unlock flexible strategies. Every hand becomes more fun, more unpredictable, and more rewarding.

Leagues & Special Events
- Progress from Bronze to Silver and toward Legendary Master at your own pace. Complete special event goals and keep making progress with every game.

Rich Rewards
- Earn coins, unlock card styles, and collect limited-time rewards through daily tasks and events.

Statistics & Game History
- Track your progress with game history and detailed statistics after each round. Review your performance, improve your strategy, and keep building your Rummy 500 skills.

Personalized Card Table
- Customize your table background, card faces, and card backs to create your own comfortable Rummy 500 playing space. Make every round feel more personal and enjoyable.

Fun Emojis & Quick Reactions
- Use expressive emojis and quick reactions to make each round feel more lively and fun.

❤️ Perfect for Fans of Classic Card Games:

- Enjoy standard Rummy 500 rules, smooth gameplay, and easy-to-read cards.
- Challenge your brain with smart melds, Jokers, and strategic discards.
- Relax and pass the time with a stress-free offline card game.

Rummy 500 combines the comfort of a relaxing card game with the satisfaction of smart strategy. Play at your own pace, enjoy every hand, and keep improving as you master classic Rummy 500 gameplay.

🎉 Download Rummy 500 today and enjoy a free-to-play classic card game that is relaxing, challenging, and fun — anytime, anywhere!

data.name: Giang Hồ Trong Tay
data.description_full:
Giấy phép cung cấp dịch vụ trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 132/GP-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục Phát thanh, Truyền hình và Thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 15/08/2025
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số 463/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục Phát thanh, truyền hình và thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 29/07/2026

【Thư thái tận hưởng, quái tan biến trong chớp mắt】
Từ lúc bắt đầu tới khi hoàn thành hành trình, hệ thống auto hoàn toàn giúp bạn rảnh tay. Mỗi trận chiến là một màn nhặt đồ mãn nhãn, nhiệm vụ chính tuyến, hang động, bí cảnh đủ cả – kiểu chơi dành riêng cho dân văn phòng, ngồi uống trà vẫn thấy chỉ số tăng vùn vụt.
【Chạm là bay, đòn đánh sướng tận óc】
Võ học muôn màu, cảm giác va chạm sắc lẹm từng cú. Hiệu ứng chiến đấu gọn mà uy lực, chẳng kiểu đứng chờ số như game cũ. Luyện thành tuyệt học rồi thì sát thương bung màn hình, nhìn thôi đã thấy đã.
【Vô số danh hiệp, chờ ngày hội ngộ】
Biết bao hảo hán kinh điển hội tụ, mỗi người một tuyệt kỹ độc bản. Cộng thêm đội hình tùy tùng quầng sáng hùng hậu, tự tay tạo nên bản trận hình trong mơ của chính mình.
【Xây dựng tự do, trí tuệ mới là vua】

data.name: PawTrail
data.description_full:
Pawtrail is a logic puzzle game where you place dogs on a grid using number clues. No guessing and no luck — every level has exactly one solution you can reach through deduction.

You act as a territory planner for a group of playful pups, finding each one an exclusive spot on the board.

How to Play
- Double-tap a cell to place a dog. Its paw prints sweep across the entire row and column in a cross shape, stopping only when blocked by an obstacle.
- Dogs are territorial: any cell already covered by paw prints cannot hold another dog.
- Numbers on the board show how many dogs surround that cell. A 0 means no dogs adjacent; a 3 means exactly three.
- Fill every cell with either a dog or paw prints to complete the level.

Features
- Difficulty range from short introductory grids to large expert boards
- Single tap to mark a cell with an X and rule it out
- No timer, and no pressure to rush a level

Solving Tips
- Start from extreme numbers. A 0 or a 4 gives you the most information on the board.
- Mark cells you have ruled out with an X to keep your reasoning visible.
- Trace where a dog's cross-shaped paw prints will reach before you place it.

Pawtrail suits players who enjoy Minesweeper-style number deduction and grid logic puzzles solved with reasoning rather than reflexes.

data.name: AetherSX2 Emulator
data.description_full:
AetherSX2 Emulator is a full-featured PlayStation 2 emulator for Android, built around a cover-art library, deep per-title configuration and a control system that adapts to how you like to play.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

AetherSX2 Emulator keeps the whole experience on a single screen. The library, your settings, save states, memory cards, texture packs and achievements are all reachable without leaving what you are doing, through a side drawer and a quick-actions panel rather than a maze of nested menus.

A LIBRARY, NOT A FILE PICKER

Point the app at a folder and it builds a proper library. Titles appear as a coverflow of box art you can swipe through, with the artwork downloaded automatically and cached on device. Search by name, sort alphabetically or by most recently opened, and long-press any title to jump straight into its own settings or set a custom cover of your own.

SAVE STATES AND MEMORY CARDS

Save state slots let you capture the exact moment you are in and return to it instantly - useful for tricky sections, or just for stopping mid-way without hunting for a save point. Alongside them, AetherSX2 Emulator gives you full virtual memory card management: create cards, switch between them, assign a separate card per title, and browse what is stored on each one.

GRAPHICS YOU CONTROL

Choose between Vulkan and OpenGL rendering, or let the app pick automatically. Scale the original output up to a resolution that suits your display, adjust blending accuracy, pick an aspect ratio, and toggle vertical sync. Widescreen patches stretch supported titles to a modern 16:9 frame, and a no-interlacing option cleans up the shimmer that older output produces on flat panels.

TEXTURE PACKS

Browse and install community-made HD texture packs from inside the app. Downloads are handled in the background with progress you can watch, and installed packs are managed from one screen - load them, precache them, or turn them off per title.

CONTROLS THAT FIT YOU

Connect a gamepad over Bluetooth or USB and it is picked up automatically, with a built-in tester so you can confirm every button and stick maps correctly. Prefer touch? The on-screen layout is fully adjustable, including an optional right-stick joystick. A quick-actions panel puts save states, settings and the library one gesture away, and controller users can open it with Select and Start together.

PER-TITLE SETTINGS

Every configuration option can be set globally or overridden for a single title, so a game that needs a different renderer or a specific blending mode keeps those settings on its own without disturbing anything else. AetherSX2 Emulator remembers your changes and reapplies them automatically next time.

CHEATS AND ACHIEVEMENTS

Load cheat files for supported titles and toggle individual codes on and off. AetherSX2 Emulator also includes achievement tracking, with progress, unlocked badges and a hardcore mode for anyone who wants the stricter ruleset.

ORGANISING YOUR COLLECTION

Add as many folders as you like and the library merges them into one view. Missing artwork can be fetched for the whole collection in a single tap, and anything that cannot be matched automatically can be given a cover you choose yourself. A refresh option rescans folders whenever you add something new.

EXTRAS WORTH KNOWING

Picture-in-picture keeps things running in a floating window while you use other apps. Custom GPU driver loading is available for devices that benefit from it. Arcade titles built on the same hardware family are supported alongside standard ones. A guided three-step setup walks you through first-run configuration, and a dark interface designed for the screen keeps everything readable in one hand.

AetherSX2 Emulator is free, has no subscription, and puts every setting in front of you rather than hiding it behind defaults.

SOLVE CLEVER ARROW PUZZLES

Each level presents a new arrangement of arrows, blocked paths, and maze-like escape routes. Look at every direction before making your move because tapping the wrong piece can block another path.

To complete a level:

• Study the direction of every piece
• Find an arrow with a clear escape route
• Tap arrows in the correct order
• Remove blockers and open new paths
• Clear the full board to win

The early levels are simple and relaxing, while later arrow puzzle games require sharper observation, better planning, and more advanced logic.

PLAY WITH 8 UNIQUE THEMES

Turn arrows into twisting snakes, linked chains, pencils, ropes, worms, skeleton-style pieces, and more. Every theme gives the board a fresh visual style while keeping the satisfying arrow puzzle gameplay you enjoy.

Choose your favorite design and become an arrow master across every theme.

A RELAXING MAZE AND ESCAPE CHALLENGE

There is always a route out. The challenge is finding it.

Clear crowded boards, solve tricky escape sequences, and guide every arrow toward freedom. Each successful move creates more space and reveals new solutions.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ARRIO

BECOME AN ARROW MASTER

Observe the complete board before tapping. Find the correct starting point, open a route through the maze, and create the perfect escape sequence.

data.name: Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match
data.description_full:
Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match is a relaxing sliding tile puzzle where every move brings the board to life. Match identical mahjong tiles, enjoy satisfying collisions, and discover clever routes through each layout. With large, readable tiles and simple controls, it offers adults, seniors, and casual puzzle fans an inviting mix of calm play and thoughtful challenge.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
Find two identical mahjong tiles on the board.
Tap matching tiles that are already aligned, or slide a tile horizontally or vertically to line it up with its match.
When the matching tiles are in the same row or column with an unobstructed path between them, they connect and disappear.
Remove every tile from the board to complete the level.

⭐ WHAT MAKES MAHJONG FLOW DIFFERENT?
🀄 Slide, Align, and Match
Pairs do not always begin next to each other. Shift tiles across open spaces, create a direct route, and bring matching symbols into position. How you move one tile can reshape the choices that follow.

🌊 Smooth, Satisfying Tile Flow
Tiles glide into place, matching pairs collide, and routes appear as the layout changes. A good sequence of moves gives every puzzle its own natural rhythm.

🧠 Spatial Thinking Made Enjoyable
Look beyond the first available pair. Choosing which tile to move can open one route while closing another, turning simple matching into an enjoyable exercise in spatial reasoning and logic.

👀 Easy-to-Read Tiles and Comfortable Design
Bold symbols, generous tile sizes, and an organized board make important details easy to recognize. The interface stays out of the way, so you can concentrate on each move.

💡 A Nudge for Tricky Moments
Hint can point out an option when you miss a route, while Shuffle changes the arrangement when you want a fresh view of the board.

📶 Offline Casual Play
No Wi-Fi is required for regular puzzle play. Continue a board during a commute, between appointments, or whenever you have a few minutes to yourself.

👴 EASY TO SETTLE INTO
Large mahjong tiles, bold symbols, and direct sliding controls keep the screen comfortable to follow. The rules are approachable for adults and seniors, while route-based decisions provide enough depth for experienced puzzle players.

Download Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match and set the tiles in motion!

Note: Mahjong Flow: Slide & Match is a casual tile-matching puzzle that uses mahjong-inspired symbols. Its slide-and-match rules are separate from traditional multiplayer mahjong gameplay.

data.name: Moto Traffic: Road Rider Go
data.description_full:
Get on the bike and enter busy roads where timing, lane choice, speed control, and clean overtakes matter. Moto Traffic: Road Rider Go is a first-person motorcycle traffic-riding game built around short objectives and longer progression. Ride through moving traffic, react to cars ahead, use the road space carefully, and reach the target before time runs out.

What you can do:
- Ride from a first-person cockpit view with on-screen steering, throttle/brake controls, and a tilt-control option.
- Take on timed distance runs and overtake-focused objectives.
- Play Career challenges and Endless rides, with progression that unlocks more content.
- Face traffic patterns on one-way and two-way roads.
- Build speed while keeping enough control to avoid crashes.
- Earn in-game rewards from riding performance and use them in the garage.
- Unlock motorcycles and upgrade performance, including top-speed progression.
- Ride through several road themes, including city streets and bridges, desert roads, industrial/factory areas, mountain routes, and snowy environments.
- Encounter changing traffic situations, checkpoints, and pursuit-style Career moments.

The road keeps you busy. A clear lane can close quickly when a car moves into your path, and a fast pass can become risky if you wait too long. Read the traffic ahead, choose when to accelerate, decide when to brake, and make space before overtaking. Timed objectives ask you to cover a required distance before the countdown ends, while other missions can focus on overtakes or progress through a route.

Career mode is designed for structured goals and progression. Some Career sequences include police-pursuit pressure, so maintaining speed and creating distance can matter as much as avoiding traffic. Endless mode lets you keep riding and push your own run farther while traffic continues around you.

Your garage gives progression a practical purpose. Unlock different motorcycles, select the bike you want to ride, and invest earned resources into upgrades. Improving a motorcycle can help you reach higher speeds, but faster riding also demands earlier reactions and cleaner lane choices.

The environments change the feel of each run. Cross bridges under open skies, ride past desert settlements and cacti, pass containers and industrial buildings, head toward mountain roads, or continue through snow-covered routes. Weather and time-of-day variations can also change the look of a session.

Controls are made for mobile play. Use the visible ride controls to steer and manage speed, or switch to the supported tilt option if you prefer motion steering. A horn is available during traffic riding, and braking is important when a gap disappears.

Moto Traffic: Road Rider Go focuses on motorcycle riding through active road traffic, timed challenges, overtaking, progression, and bike upgrades. It does not rely on claims of real-world driving or professional simulation: the goal is an arcade-style traffic ride with clear objectives and responsive mobile controls.

Choose a bike, enter the road, watch the traffic, and see how far you can ride.

data.name: Silkroad Origin Mobile Arabia
data.description_full:
سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا هي النسخة الرسمية للموبايل من سيلكرود أونلاين، والمرخصة عالميا من قبل وي ميد ماكس (كوريا الجنوبية)، المعروفة سابقا باسم جوي ماكس، وقد طورت خصيصا لمجتمع العالم العربي.

مستوحاة من طريق الحرير الأسطوري، الذي ربط عبر التراث الممتد لآلاف السنين بين الحضارات والتجار وقوافل الكارفان، تعيد سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا اللاعبين إلى رحلة المسافرين، حيث أصبحت الشجاعة، وروح الأخوة، والكرم قيما خالدة تتوارثها الأجيال..

التراث يفتح الطريق - والضيافة ترشد الدرب

على الطرق الممتدة عبر الصحراء، لم تكن النجوم وحدها هي التي تهدي المسافرين إلى وجهتهم، بل أيضا نور مجلسٍ مفتوح الأبواب دائما، حيث يستقبل كل ضيف بالتقدير والكرم وبروح التآخي والتعاون.

لقد أصبح هذا النهج جزءًا أصيلًا من الثقافة العربية، وهو أيضًا مصدر الإلهام الذي بُنيت عليه سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا. فهي ليست مجرد لعبة، بل مساحة يلتقي فيها أفراد المجتمع، ويتواصلون، ويواصلون معًا كتابة أسطورة سيلكرود في عصرٍ جديد.

تعود أسطورة سيلكرود إلى الحياة على الموبايل

ترث سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا روح سيلكرود أونلاين الكلاسيكية بكل تفاصيلها، مع الحفاظ على الرسومات الأصلية التي أحبها اللاعبون. فمن الصحارى الشاسعة، إلى المدن المزدهرة، وصولًا إلى السراديب العريقة التي تخفي الكنوز وأسرار التاريخ، تحمل كل رحلة تحدياتٍ جديدة بانتظار المسافرين الشجعان.

المهن الكلاسيكية الثلاث: التاجر، الصياد، واللصوص

اختر طريقك الخاص على طريق الحرير: التاجر، اللصوص، أو الصياد، وهي المهن الثلاث الكلاسيكية التي صنعت أسطورة طريق الحرير. لكل مهنة أسلوب لعبها الخاص، واستراتيجيتها المميزة، ودورها الفريد في الصراع للسيطرة على طرق التجارة الحيوية بين الصين وأوروبا. أما نظام المهارات الأصلي، الذي جرى تحسينه ليتناسب مع الموبايل، فيمنحك تجربة قتال واقعية ومتوازنة.

ساحة الشرف

من معارك النقابة الضخمة إلى الصراع من أجل السيطرة على طرق التجارة، لا تجلب كل انتصار المكافآت فحسب، بل يرسخ أيضا شرف المجتمع بأكمله، وشجاعته، وقوته.

هنا تُولد الأساطير الجديدة.

نسخة مخصصة للعالم العربي

لا تقتصر سيلكرود أوريجن موبايل أرابيا على الترجمة إلى اللغة العربية فحسب، بل خضعت أيضا لعملية توطين متكاملة لتنسجم مع ثقافة المنطقة ولغتها وعادات لاعبيها.

ابتداء من الواجهة العربية، والرسومات، والرموز، والفعاليات، وصولًا إلى الأنشطة المجتمعية، صمم كل عنصر باحترام للهوية المحلية، ليقدم تجربة أصيلة، قريبة من اللاعبين، ومستدامة.

لم يكن طريق الحرير يوما مجرد طريق للتجارة..

بل كان رحلة جمعت بين الشعوب، والثقافات، والقيم التي توارثتها الأجيال. واليوم، تستمر تلك الأسطورة على الموبايل. ابدأ رحلتك على الطريق الذي كان دائمًا طريقنا.

The maze chapter leads through repeating corridors, misleading doors, concealed turns, and dead ends. Environmental clues can reveal the correct path while sudden hazards make each escape route harder to navigate.
A later chapter takes place in an abandoned dental wing. Avoid moving tools, unstable platforms, and a hostile pursuer while searching for the door to the next area.
As the stages progress, routes become longer and hazards appear in new combinations. Learn each layout, improve your timing, and guide the cats through dangerous locations.

• Action-platformer levels with a group of cats
• Running, jumping, climbing, and obstacle-based movement
• Traps, damaged machinery, and moving platforms
• Monster chases through dark corridors
• Maze sections with misleading doors and hidden passages
• A separate chapter inside an abandoned dental wing

data.name: My Little Village

Build close-knit neighborly relationships and watch your community grow stronger every day. Complete quests from residents to earn rewards and unlock new content.

Golden rice fields, water buffaloes lazily grazing, a shimmering fish pond in the afternoon, and the cheerful laughter of neighbors — a peaceful, tranquil atmosphere that brings you back to your most beautiful childhood memories. The traditional Vietnamese countryside setting is authentically recreated with a cute, bright, and familiar art style. Experience the beauty of folk culture, traditional crafts, bustling village markets, and vibrant village festivals.

data.name: Mastercraft Building Craft

Creative Mode: Players are provided with unlimited resources (blocks) to build whatever they can imagine—ranging from simple houses and majestic castles to modern architectural marvels. In this mode, there are no threats from enemies, and players have the ability to fly freely.

Survival Mode: Players start from scratch. You must gather natural resources, craft tools, hunt for food, and build a shelter before nightfall to survive attacks from monsters and zombies.

The game features a vast, varied, and randomly generated world. Players can explore diverse biomes—such as dense forests, deserts, and snowy mountains—as well as mysterious underground caves to mine valuable resources.

True to its name, crafting is at the heart of the game. Players can transform raw materials like wood and stone into weapons, armor, furniture, and even mechanical tools to streamline tasks within the game.

Mastercraft Building Craft is the choice for fans of crafting and building games.

data.name: Crazy Joker
data.description_full:
Welcome to Crazy Joker, a memory puzzle game where you reveal hidden puzzle pieces, remember their positions, and rebuild the complete picture.
Each level begins with a short preview of the full puzzle. After a few seconds, every piece is turned face down. Use your memory to reveal pieces and drag them into the correct positions.
As correctly matched neighboring pieces come together, they automatically connect into groups. Connected groups move together, helping you gradually restore the entire picture.
The game becomes more challenging as puzzle boards grow larger, requiring better memory and careful planning.

• Preview the puzzle before the challenge begins
• Reveal hidden puzzle pieces
• Drag and swap puzzle pieces
• Automatically connect correctly matched pieces
• Memory-based puzzle gameplay
• Smooth and simple controls
• Increasing puzzle difficulty
• Relaxing brain-training experience
Can you remember every piece and complete the whole picture?
Download Crazy Joker and enjoy a fun memory puzzle challenge!

data.name: TileMatch-Mahjong
data.description_full:
TileMatch is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle game inspired by classic
mahjong. Find three identical tiles from layered stacks, collect them
in the bar, and watch them clear in a satisfying burst. No timers,
no pressure — just pure puzzle enjoyment.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap any uncovered tile to send it to the collection bar at the bottom.
• Match 3 tiles of the same pattern to clear them from the bar.
• Clear all tiles from the board to win.
• If the bar fills up (7 slots) without a match, it's game over.

FEATURES
• 12 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty.
• Multi-layered tile stacking — upper tiles block lower ones.
Plan your moves carefully.
• 8 unique mahjong tile patterns to recognize and match.
• Star rating system — earn up to 3 stars per level based on
your performance.
• 3 power-ups: Shuffle, +1 Slot, and Force Match to help you
out of tight spots.
• Fully offline — play anywhere, no internet needed.
• Clean, elegant visuals with a traditional Chinese mahjong
aesthetic.
• No ads, no timers, no pressure. Just you and the tiles.

WHO IS IT FOR
TileMatch is for anyone who enjoys a calm, thoughtful puzzle.
Whether you have 5 minutes on your commute or want to unwind
before bed, each level offers a satisfying mental workout that
fits into your day. No frantic tapping, no countdowns — just
the quiet satisfaction of clearing the board.
data.description_short: Relaxing mahjong tile match puzzle. Match 3 identical tiles to clear the board.

data.name: Worm Smash - Worm Escape Game
data.description_full:
Worm Smash brings worms to fans of worm games. Begin a logic puzzle focused on spatial reasoning, sequencing, and problem-solving. Each arrow puzzle offers clear rules and a solution to uncover. Fans of brain games compare routes, test deductions, and build puzzle-solving skills. Every brain puzzle rewards memory, pattern recognition, and careful analysis.

How to Play
🧭 In each logic puzzle, every worm follows its direction. You can tap away a worm only when its path is open. Clear the arrow puzzle by creating space step by step.
👆 Worm games use simple rules. Brain games keep choices meaningful. Each brain puzzle asks you to compare open paths. The tap away order matters because one blocked route affects later moves.
🐛 A logic puzzle move sends one worm away and clears a bug. As each arrow puzzle opens, new routes appear. Worm games show steady progress. Brain games reward each clear.
🧠 Plan how to tap away worms in tight spaces. Treat every brain puzzle as small decisions. An arrow puzzle becomes easier when you check outer routes.

Puzzle Features
🌀 Each logic puzzle changes the layout. Fans of brain games remember blocked lanes and predict a tap. Worm games reward adjustment.
🎯 The tap away action stays clear and responsive.
💡 Trace each brain puzzle from its starting direction. In an arrow puzzle, a safe move opens room for nearby worms. Worm games reward planning.
🧩 Order gives brain games depth without complex controls.
🔍 Use tap away controls to move worms and clear bugs. A clean logic puzzle removes both groups step by step. Each brain puzzle ends when the last route opens and the final bug is cleared.
🌈 Readable directions make every arrow puzzle easy to follow. Short brain games practice attention and sequencing. Changing layouts keep tap away challenges varied.

Complete a logic puzzle by reading spatial relationships and applying a deliberate solution. A well-ordered brain puzzle rewards patience. Worm games invite another challenge. Puzzle games reward a return.

data.description_full:
Niti Rummy is a casual 13-card Indian Rummy practice game.

Game Rules:

• Each of the four players draws 13 cards from a standard 52-card deck.

• Designate one card as the wild card for the round.

• When it's your turn, draw a card from the face-up deck or the deck, then discard one card.

• Form at least two straights, at least one of which must be a straight (without the wild card).

• Complete the remaining hand with a straight or a flush (three of a kind or four of a kind).

• When you have all 13 cards, you declare yourself the winner of the round.

Scoring is based on practice points, calculated according to the remaining unpaired hands of your opponents. The first player to achieve the matching goal wins the round.

data.name: Codoku
data.description_full:
Codoku: Colors Sudoku is a vibrant, logic-based puzzle game that strips away traditional numbers and replaces them with a spectrum of distinct colors. By swapping digits for visual elements, the game transforms classic grid deduction into an engaging, pattern-recognition challenge that exercises visual memory and spatial reasoning. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Core Gameplay Mechanics
The game takes the foundational mechanics of traditional Sudoku and maps them to a multi-colored layout. Instead of relying on numerical tracking, players must think visually. [6, 7]

* The Rainbow Grid: The puzzle features a standard 9 × 9 layout. This major grid is split into nine standalone rows, nine vertical columns, and nine smaller 3 × 3 zones. [1, 7]
* The Objective: Fill the entire board so that each row, column, and 3 × 3 zone contains nine distinct colours without a single duplicate. [1]
* The Starting Setup: Each puzzle boots up with a fixed set of pre-placed colour blocks. These "clues" are locked into place and cannot be altered or moved, serving as your logical anchor points for the rest of the board. [1, 7, 8]
* Pure Deduction: No mathematical calculations or counting are required. Victory is achieved entirely through the process of elimination, pattern tracking, and careful visual placement. [2, 9, 10, 11, 12]

How to Play & Basic Strategy
Because your brain registers hues differently than it does numbers, the mental approach shifts away from counting to spatial scanning.

1. Isolate a Single Palette: Focus your attention on one specific colour at a time. Trace its pre-existing positions across the board to figure out where its placement is restricted in adjacent zones.
2. Scan the Boundaries: Look for rows, columns, or 3 × 3 sections that are already heavily crowded with colors. The fewer open slots a region has, the easier it is to deduce which remaining shades fit perfectly. [1, 6, 13]
3. Cross-Reference Intersection Points: If a particular cell sits at the intersection of a row and column that collectively display eight of the nine possible variations, that cell's true identity is immediately revealed by the process of elimination. [7, 13]

Key Benefits & Audience Appeal
Codoku alters how the brain processes logical constraints, offering unique advantages over its numerical predecessor:

* Overcoming Math Anxiety: Many individuals shy away from traditional puzzles because numbers feel intimidating. Codoku provides an identical cognitive workout using purely artistic and visual cues.
* Brain Activation: Studies on colour-based puzzle games reveal that tracking vibrant hues activates a broad network across multiple brain lobes. This balances spatial recognition with hard logic.
* Accessibility for All Ages: The visual layout makes the game highly intuitive for children. It acts as an excellent tool for developing early problem-solving skills, and its scale can be adjusted down to a 4 × 4 or 6 × 6 layout for beginners.
* Digital Convenience: Modern digital adaptations feature responsive click-to-select palettes, clear mistake highlighting, and hint mechanisms designed to keep gameplay moving seamlessly without the mess of paper and pencils. [2, 7, 14, 15]

Essential Rules to Remember
* Each color must appear exactly once per horizontal row.
* Each color must appear exactly once per vertical column.
* Each color must appear exactly once per bordered 3 × 3 box.
* Locked starting blocks cannot be modified. [1, 7, 16, 17, 18]

If you want to dive deeper, let me know:

* Would you like tips on designing a physical DIY version using tiles or pegs?
* Are you looking for a python algorithm to automatically solve colour grids?
* Do you want to see how to handle advanced strategies like color-chain linking?

data.name: RummyMaster King
data.description_full:
RummyMaster King is a classic four-player rummy game using a standard 52-card deck.

Each player is dealt 7 cards. The remaining cards form a deck, with one card initially in the discard pile. When it's your turn, you can draw or discard a card from the deck, then play in sequence: a straight flush (a straight of the same suit), a straight flush (a straight of the same suit), a combination of cards already on the table, and finally discard one card.

The first player to run out of cards wins the round. Scoring is based on the remaining dead cards of opponents (A=1 point, number cards are counted at face value, J, Q, K are counted as 10 points). The first player to reach 100 points wins the game.

RummyMaster King lets you experience the fun and relaxation of strategy games even in your spare time. Download Rummy and embark on a classic card game journey full of wisdom and leisure, making every step a delightful experience!

data.name: Mist Lichen Haven
data.description_full: Mist Lichen Haven is a vertical jungle‑themed multiple‑matching elimination mobile game that blends quick reflexes with mental arithmetic strategy. The board is a 5×4 tropical fruit array, each fruit bearing a number from 2 to 9. Within a 60‑second time limit, players swipe to connect two fruits—when the larger number is exactly a multiple of the smaller one, a jungle pet leaps up to collect the pair and score. A wrong match causes the target fruit to rot and deducts points. Five consecutive correct matches trigger a “Monkey Feast,” doubling the score for a period. Empty slots are filled by fruits falling from above with physics. Simple controls, yet you need to watch the clock, calculate multiples, and maintain combos all at once—perfect for high‑score sprints and sustained strategic challenges.

data.name: 三國觀滄海：水墨風三國戰棋
data.description_full:
【遊戲介紹】
三國戰棋，縱覽滄海
《三國觀滄海》以傳統水墨工筆美術，描摹出令人耳目一新的三國亂世。各位明公將在這亂世繪卷中扮演那個時代割據一方的英雄，用經典戰棋玩法調兵遣將，思當年豪傑之慮，謀當年明公之策，再現當年傳奇之路。

滾滾長江東逝水，浪花淘盡英雄
《三國觀滄海》現已同《三國演義》電視劇主題曲達成正式合作。在此也非常感謝原曲方對我們製作的三國故事的認可。諸位明公將伴隨《滾滾長江東逝水》的旋律，感受沉浸式視·聽·玩體驗，共繪這卷亂世水墨三國。

水墨工筆描摹的三國亂世
狼毫揮灑間，三國亂世徐徐展開。本作採用我們最熟悉的水墨工筆、傳統工筆美術，在遊戲中勾勒出一幅中式畫卷。在您入兗州、平豫州、收徐州的征伐過程中，恍若展開兒時珍藏的連環畫冊。

英雄視角展開的三國百態
諸侯會盟討董，官渡決戰袁紹。在第一個劇本【魏武揮鞭】中，諸位明公將以曹操的第一視角親歷風雲激盪的漢末三國。從舉事發跡到大戰轉折，您將體驗曹操波瀾壯闊的戎馬生涯，細品魏武一生……本次更新至官渡之戰，而以劉備為主角的【匡扶漢室】及更多英雄劇本，也將逐步為大家呈現。

奇謀戰術定勝的戰場棋局
謀定而後動，一計定乾坤。在步步為營的戰棋戰場上，《三國觀滄海》遵循一套敵我雙方共通的合擊系統，兩名武將將敵人夾擊時即可打出合擊。輔以拓寬決策廣度的經典奇謀，敵軍壓境時，可使猛火計火燒連營；攻城難下時，可使洪水計灌城克敵；陷入重圍時，可使奇兵天降援助逆襲……多角度構成立體化的博弈體驗。

酣戰豪雄數合的單挑決戰
斬顏良誅文醜，過五關斬六將。本作在先前版本的單挑對決表演上，更新了單挑環節的手操對戰。還原了演義中的經典單挑場面，溫酒斬華雄的利落斬將、馬超許褚大戰上百回合的巔峰對決……是一場短兵相接，火星四濺；亦是百步穿楊，弓折刀盡，都將由明公專屬的單挑戰術決定。

狼煙已起，墨硯已備，恭候明公執子入局，共繪三國！

data.name: Arrows Amaze Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrows Amaze Puzzle – a clean, thought-provoking logic puzzle game. No flashy frills, just carefully arranged arrows and a board waiting to be cleared. Your goal is simple: slide every arrow out in the right order, turning a tangled grid back into empty space. Each level is a small mental challenge – with every deliberate move, chaos gradually gives way to clarity.

- Scan the board for an arrow that has a clear straight path to the edge.
- Tap it, and the arrow slides out elegantly, freeing up space around it.
- Each move changes the layout, so you'll need to plan the sequence carefully. A wrong tap that causes a "collision" will cost you a water droplet 💧.
- When the situation gets tricky, use the hint feature – it will fairly show you a currently movable arrow.
- Clear all arrows to complete the level. Aim for a flawless run to unlock greater satisfaction.

◆ Game Features
- Ultra‑clean interface with no visual clutter, letting your brain focus fully on each decision. 😌
- Quick loading and smooth controls for an uninterrupted immersive experience. 🚀
- A solid brain workout – tests your foresight, sequencing, and spatial awareness. 🗺️
- Responsive tap feedback and clear path cues; every successful arrow removal brings a small sense of achievement. 😎
- When you're stuck, the smart hint item gently lights up a safe move without breaking your thinking flow. 💡

On your commute, during a short break – just one minute is enough for a quick mental refresh. If you have more time, hundreds of carefully crafted layouts will keep you engaged. The difficulty ramps up gradually, from simple open patterns to intricate tangles, ensuring a satisfying challenge that never feels boring or frustrating.

Download Arrows Amaze Puzzle now. Plan your routes, protect every water droplet 💧, and slide each arrow away – at your own pace, enjoying the pure pleasure of focused problem‑solving.

Players need to quickly observe and screen identical or rule-matching number tiles, select and pair eligible tiles to clear grid spaces and complete level tasks. The game includes diverse matching rules, including identical number pairing, adjacent sequence matching and symmetric numeric combination, avoiding single repetitive gameplay. Level difficulty increases progressively with grid size, tile quantity and matching complexity, balancing casual entertainment and intellectual challenge. The smooth tap-and-match operation is easy to get started, while advanced levels require careful observation and strategic selection to avoid dead-end layouts. The clean visual design and comfortable interactive feedback bring a pleasant gaming experience. Players can take their time to analyze tile distribution without urgent time pressure, making it an ideal pastime for daily fragmented moments. Continuous level unlocking brings richer grid layouts and more flexible matching rules, constantly refreshing gameplay experience. By repeatedly practicing tile matching and grid clearing, players can improve their observation speed, reaction ability and logical screening thinking. This lightweight numeric matching game delivers simple, pure and long-lasting intellectual fun through classic grid puzzle gameplay.

data.name: Splash Kingdom: Tower Blast
data.description_full:
The water is calm. The items are stacked. Your cannon is loaded. Welcome to Splash Kingdom — a sun-soaked world of floating stack puzzles, precision cannon shots, and the most satisfying crashes on the water.
Dive into a world where towering stacks of items float on a shimmering sea just waiting to be brought down. Load your cannon, take aim, and fire off the perfect shot — shattering glass bottles, tipping cargo containers, and chipping away at ice blocks, sending them all tumbling into the water in a cascade of satisfying destruction.
Each level is a physics puzzle that rewards clever thinkers. With limited cannon shots, your eagle eyes will spot the weak point in each structure, plan your angle, and pull off chain reactions that collapse entire stacks at once. Heavy steel anchors hold firm while light wooden crates splinter under pressure, and a single wobbling rope coil can bring it all crashing down! The mechanics are easy to pick up and endlessly rewarding to master.
Every impact is tuned to hit just right. The crunch of ice breaking, the clang of tumbling metal, the splash as it all hits the water — pure ASMR bliss. And that feeling when one perfect shot triggers a full collapse never gets old.
But the water has its secrets. From the earliest levels, you'll see this is no mindless tap-fest. Clever layouts, tricky blockers, and new item types force you to rethink your approach with each challenge. Structures grow more complex, angles get trickier, and the puzzle logic deepens the further you go. But watching it all crash into the sea — with a fresh new stack rising in its place — makes every shot worth it!
Compete with players around the world, climb the leaderboard, and prove your aim is the sharpest at sea. Every cleared level and perfectly executed chain reaction earns you rewards and brings you closer to the top.
Splash Kingdom is your new go-to for physics puzzle satisfaction: a beautifully crafted water world filled with clever puzzles, powerful boosters, and the pure joy of watching structures collapse exactly the way you planned.
Every shot is a chance to crash through. Every cleared level feels like a perfect wave. So load up, take aim, and start the most satisfying physics puzzle on the water.
Download Splash Kingdom today and feel the crash!

data.name: Arrow Smash：Earn Cash

One wrong step and you lose a heart! Solve puzzles, earn rewards, and watch your cash grow.

Gameplay Overview:

Each puzzle presents you with a grid of colorful arrows pointing in different directions. To solve the puzzle, you must tap and extract each arrow in the correct order, ensuring that no two arrows collide along their paths. As you progress, the grids grow larger, the paths become more complex, and your planning skills are pushed to the limit. Every successful clear earns you rewards – the smarter you play, the more you earn!

Key Features:

Simple Yet Deep Mechanics: Easy to understand, but increasingly challenging to master. Every level requires careful thought and strategic sequencing.

Earn Real Cash: Solve puzzles and complete challenges to unlock real cash rewards. The more levels you clear, the more you earn!

Thousands of Handcrafted Levels: Each level is meticulously designed to offer a unique challenge. With thousands of puzzles to solve, you'll never run out of brain-teasing fun.

Minimalist & Clean Design: A distraction-free visual style that lets you focus entirely on the puzzle. Beautiful colors and smooth animations make every move a pleasure.

Relaxing, No-Pressure Gameplay: No timers, no rushing, no stress. Play at your own pace and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.

Hint System: Stuck on a tough level? Use hints to get a gentle nudge in the right direction and keep progressing.

Heart System: You start each puzzle with a set of hearts. Make a mistake and lose one – clear the grid without losing them all to achieve a perfect victory and bigger rewards!

Perfect for Quick Sessions or Long Play: Whether you have five minutes or an hour, Arrow Smash: Earn Cash fits your schedule.

Why You'll Love It:

Arrow Smash: Earn Cash is the perfect game for players who love to exercise their brain without the pressure of timers or fast reflexes. It's just you, the grid, and the satisfying challenge of finding the perfect sequence. Every solved puzzle brings a sense of accomplishment and real rewards – and every mistake teaches you to plan better. It's calm, it's clever, and it's completely addictive.

Download now and see if you can clear the grid without losing a single heart – and start earning today!

data.name: Number Grid Builder
data.description_full: Number Grid Builder is a strategic numeric puzzle game focused on grid construction and logical number arrangement. Designed for logic game enthusiasts and casual puzzle players, this app provides a clean grid gameplay experience centered on building orderly numeric layouts through careful thinking and strategic placement. Players will face blank grid boards of varying sizes and a series of numbered tiles with unique matching rules. The core gameplay requires users to analyze numeric sequences, spatial rules and grid constraints, then place and arrange number tiles reasonably to build complete, compliant grid structures. The game features progressive difficulty levels, starting from simple small-grid beginner stages to help players grasp basic number matching and grid building logic, gradually advancing to complex large-grid challenges with multi-layered rule restrictions. Multiple core gameplay modes are integrated, including sequence arrangement, symmetric grid building and numeric interval matching, ensuring diverse and long-lasting puzzle fun. Every grid layout follows independent logical rules, requiring players to observe, deduce and adjust tile positions repeatedly to eliminate mismatched arrangements. The minimalist interface and smooth operation bring a focused gaming experience without redundant interference. There are no rigid time limits, allowing players to think at their own pace and exercise logical thinking and spatial planning abilities in fragmented leisure time. As players progress, more sophisticated grid templates and advanced numeric rule mechanisms will be unlocked to enrich gameplay depth. Each completed grid structure can be saved and reviewed, recording every logical thinking process. This pure logic-based puzzle game cultivates rigorous reasoning habits and spatial layout skills, bringing relaxing and fulfilling intellectual entertainment experience.

data.name: BetPawa

BetPawa is a fast-paced memory game where you flip cards to find matching symbols. Each level features a dark grid filled with face-down cards displaying stars, circles, diamonds, and other colorful icons. ⏱️✨

The objective is simple: memorize the position of the symbols, match every pair, and complete the level using as few moves as possible. The screen tracks the number of pairs found and moves made in real time, making every decision count.

🎮 Flip the cards and find matching pairs

• Tap the first card to reveal its symbol
• Flip a second card and compare the two icons
• If the symbols match, the pair remains visible
• If the cards are different, they turn face down again
• Find all 10 pairs to complete the level

Use Hint to get help when you are stuck, or select Shuffle to rearrange the grid and try a new approach. These accessible mechanics provide a memory challenge suitable for players of all skill levels.

🏆 Progress and improve your results

The game includes more than 10 levels with progressively increasing difficulty. The first grids help you learn the rules quickly, while later levels require greater concentration and stronger memorization skills.

Each completed level can award up to three stars based on your performance. Earned coins add to the sense of progression, while replaying levels allows you to improve your result and aim for a higher rating.

Success depends entirely on your memory, attention, and ability to avoid unnecessary moves.

🌟 Main features

• Classic card-matching gameplay
• More than 10 levels
• Progressively challenging grids
• Tracking of matched pairs and moves
• Rating system with up to three stars
• Coin rewards
• Hint and Shuffle functions
• Simple mobile controls

🧩 A clear and modern presentation

BetPawa uses a dark palette combining black, burgundy, and pink, with bright cards and easy-to-recognize symbols. Its visual identity creates a clear, pleasant, and independent puzzle experience.

Rounds are short enough for a quick break, while level-based progression also works well for longer sessions. The mobile format makes it easy to play at any time.

data.name: Bash Fiesta
data.description_full:
Bash Fiesta is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where you destroy structures by triggering bombs on a connected grid.

Instead of placing objects, the game focuses on interacting with structures and using physics-based reactions to clear each level. Every stage requires timing, logic, and strategic thinking to find the best way to eliminate all targets.

● SIMPLE GAMEPLAY
Tap or trigger structures to activate bombs and destroy connected elements.
Clear all targets on the board to complete the level.
Each action creates chain reactions that affect the entire structure.
Easy to understand but deeply strategic gameplay.

● HOW IT WORKS
Each level is built around physics-based destruction mechanics.
You must find the optimal sequence of interactions to trigger chain reactions.
Some structures collapse instantly, while others require multiple hits or indirect impacts.
As levels progress, layouts become more complex and require careful planning.
Every decision matters and wrong timing can prevent full clearance.

● PROGRESSIVE DIFFICULTY
Early levels introduce basic destruction mechanics.
Later levels add layered structures and more complex interactions.
Advanced stages require precise timing and strategic chain reactions.

● GAME FEATURES
Physics-based destruction puzzle
Chain reaction mechanics
No time limits
Offline supported
Increasing difficulty levels
Clean and satisfying visual effects

Relax and enjoy a satisfying destruction puzzle experience.
Download Bash Fiesta and master the art of strategic explosions.

data.name: 33AGGlobal
data.description_full: 33AGGlobal is a vertical rhythm‑action mobile game that combines precise timing control with nutrient synthesis mechanics. Players tap the screen to flip falling gel prisms onto induction coils, then complete a second flip within the golden synthesis window—tapping too early results in raw failure, too late causes scorching and waste. After successful setting, tapping again triggers a robotic arm to plate the nutrient block for points. As the score rises, the timing window narrows and falling speed increases, testing reaction and judgment. Easy to pick up yet strategically rich.
data.description_short: 33AGGlobal is a rhythm‑action mobile game.

data.name: 33AGModule
data.description_full: 33AGModule is a vertical magic crafting mobile game that combines sequential memory with timed operation. Players follow the crafting recipe shown on the left scroll, tapping the correct order of magical ingredients—cloud bread, flame patties, emerald leaves, moon cheese, sun tomatoes, and crystal onions—and layering them into the central cauldron to complete the ritual. Each round has a countdown; selecting the wrong order or running out of time costs a life crystal. When three crystals are depleted, the ritual fails. As the score rises, recipes grow longer, more ingredients become available, and time limits tighten, demanding calm judgment and precise tapping. The clean interface and clear rules make it easy to pick up, while the rhythmic pressure and strategic depth encourage repeated attempts to achieve higher scores.
data.description_short: 33AGModule is a magic crafting mobile game.

data.name: JW88Vexis
data.description_full: JW88Vexis is a vertical logic circuit puzzle mobile game centered on level‑based challenges and strategic wiring. Players drag and place various logic gates on a hexagonal board, wiring input signals correctly to outputs to light up all target nodes and clear the level. The levels cover gate types including AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, and NOR. Step count and time affect star ratings. Players can use tools like hints, undo, and time freeze to aid puzzle‑solving, and replenish them with coins in the shop. With 50 progressively challenging levels, clear rules, and a quick learning curve, it demands thoughtful planning of wiring and gate placement—ideal for players who enjoy brain‑teasing puzzles and repeated attempts.
data.description_short: JW88Vexis is a circuit puzzle mobile game.

data.name: VV55Rage
data.description_full: VV55Rage is a vertical casual slicing mobile game that combines quick reaction with precise swipe controls. Thorn buds continuously emerge on the screen, slowly growing from the bottom stems, gradually blooming, and swaying slightly with the rhythm. Players must swipe their finger across targets that are not yet fully mature to harvest them; each successful harvest earns points, while the spawn rate and growth tempo gradually accelerate. If more than eight targets accumulate simultaneously, the challenge ends immediately. The game supports pause, restart, high-score recording, and tutorial access. The rules are easy to learn, yet later stages demand rhythm planning, path selection, and on-the-spot judgment, offering both tension and strategic depth.

Every category, every word, every clue in this game was built for Malayalis. Not translated. Not adapted. Built from scratch, with the kind of references that only make sense if you grew up watching the same films, eating the same food, and arguing about the same things.

The word list went through real playtesting with real friend groups across Kerala before anything made it into the game. Too generic and the game loses its edge. Too obscure and half the table goes quiet. Every word is in that sweet spot, familiar enough to play with, specific enough to catch someone out.

How to play:
One player gets a different word from everyone else. Everyone asks questions, gives answers, and tries to figure out who's the imposter, without giving away their own word. The imposter tries to blend in long enough to survive the vote. Simple to explain. Hard to win. Impossible to stop playing.

data.name: LineAlign
data.description_full: LineAlign is a vertical fantasy minesweeper puzzle mobile game that blends classic logic deduction with a cave‑exploration atmosphere. Players find themselves in a dim mine, facing a grid of interlocking diamond‑shaped crystal tiles. By tapping to reveal unknown areas and long‑pressing to place warning flags, they advance step by step on a 9×9 board. Hidden among the tiles are ten shadow crystals, some of which carry cursed power—mistapping one deducts a significant amount of points. Safe areas are marked with colorful gem clusters indicating the number of adjacent mines, helping players deduce their next move. The game is timed at sixty seconds, keeping the pace tight. Players can also use the "Detection Eye" up to three times to automatically reveal a safe tile, turning the tide in critical moments. Score accumulates based on the number of safe tiles revealed, and successfully avoiding all mines wins the round. The rules are straightforward yet strategically deep, making it easy to pick up in spare moments while still testing observation and on‑the‑spot judgment.
data.description_short: LineAlign is a minesweeper puzzle mobile game.

data.name: RTZZDiora
data.description_full: RTZZDiora is a vertical grid territory conquest strategy mobile game that combines encirclement tactics with step‑by‑step strategic gameplay. Players control their own army on an 8x12 battlefield, placing new troops in empty cells adjacent to their own units to expand territory. Surrounding enemy cities converts them into allied strongholds and earns points, while players must constantly defend their own capital—if it is completely surrounded by the enemy, the battle is lost. The enemy AI autonomously places pieces and accelerates its advance; as levels increase, it deploys more city outposts and shortens action intervals, making the situation increasingly tense. When neither side has a legal move left, victory is determined by the number of troops and action points on the field, and the winning side advances to the next wave. The game supports pause and resume, records the highest historical score, and features vibration feedback. The rules are simple and clear, yet contain deep strategic thinking in layout and offense‑defense transitions, making it suitable for players who enjoy light strategy and fast‑paced duels to repeatedly challenge themselves.

data.name: Gems Blast!
data.description_full:
Get ready to sort, match, and collect a dazzling stream of colorful gems in Gems Blast!

Gems Blast! is a satisfying 3D sorting puzzle where sparkling gems, moving trays, and clever decisions come together. Your goal is to release the gems in the right order, send them onto the rotating conveyor, and collect them in matching containers before the available space runs out.

The rules may look simple, but every move matters. Observe the colors, plan ahead, and find the best sequence to clear every gem. As the levels become more challenging, you will need sharper logic, better timing, and smarter sorting strategies to complete each puzzle.

Can you organize every gem without blocking the conveyor?

KEY FEATURES
💎 Satisfying Gem-Sorting Gameplay
Drop colorful gems, watch them move across the conveyor, and collect them in their matching containers.
✨ Bright and Sparkling 3D Visuals
Enjoy vibrant gem colors, polished animations, and an eye-catching puzzle environment designed to make every level feel rewarding.
🧠 Challenging Logic Puzzles
Each level introduces a new arrangement of gems and containers. Study the board carefully and choose the correct order to clear them all.
🔄 Dynamic Moving Conveyor
Gems travel around a rotating conveyor after being released. Manage the limited space and avoid creating an impossible situation.
🎮 Simple One-Tap Controls
Tap to release gems from the upper trays. The controls are easy to understand, while the puzzles require careful thinking to master.
🎧 Relaxing and Satisfying Experience
Smooth gem movements, sparkling effects, and satisfying collection moments create a calming puzzle experience.
📈 Increasing Difficulty
Begin with simple sorting challenges and gradually face more complex layouts, crowded trays, and difficult color combinations.

HOW TO PLAY
✅ Tap a tray to release the available gems.
✅ Watch the gems fall onto the moving conveyor.
✅ Match each gem with a container of the same color.
✅ Fill all the required spaces to complete a matching container.
✅ Pay attention to the order of the gems before making your next move.
✅ Keep the conveyor from becoming completely full.
✅ Clear every gem to finish the level and move on to the next challenge.
Be careful! Releasing the wrong color too early may take up valuable conveyor space. When there is no room left and no available matching container, the puzzle is over.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE GEMS BLAST!
Gems Blast! combines relaxing visuals with thoughtful sorting challenges. It is easy to start playing, but finding the perfect sequence becomes increasingly satisfying as the puzzles grow more complex.

Whether you want a quick brain exercise, a calming break, or a puzzle that rewards careful planning, Gems Blast! offers an enjoyable experience for every type of casual puzzle player.

data.name: Hide & Seek: Chameleon
data.description_full:
🎨 Paint yourself to hide! A new online hide and seek multiplayer game with a chameleon stickman twist!

Welcome to Hide & Seek: Chameleon - a fresh take on hide and seek online multiplayer where the way you hide is the whole game. You spawn as a pure white stickman, and your only tool is paint. Camouflage yourself into the stage, mimic every prop and wall, and deceive the Seekers in this one-of-a-kind multiplayer party game.

🦎 HOW TO PLAY
Each match splits players into two teams: Hiders and Seekers. Hiders must paint their white bodies to camouflage with the environment - furniture, plants, walls, floors, anything a chameleon could blend into. Strike a pose, hold still, and trust your paint job. Seekers must hunt down every Hider before the clock runs out.

When the timer ends, every Hider still in disguise wins the round. If the Seekers spot everyone, the Seekers win. Easy to learn, hard to master.

🎨 WHY CHAMELEON HIDERS WIN
• Paint-to-hide mechanic - hiding is a skill, not a coin flip
• Pure white canvas body - every stickman chameleon starts the same
• Detailed stages - kitchens, gardens, rooftops, museums, offices
• Skill-based camouflage - your art decides your survival
• Mobile-first paint controls - smooth and satisfying

👥 ONLINE MULTIPLAYER PARTY GAME
Play hide and seek online with friends in a private room, or jump into public matches with chameleons from around the world. Public servers make it easy to meet new players and play hide and seek multiplayer with anyone, anytime. Recommended 2-10 players per match.

Host a private game for friends, or open your server to the community. No friends online right now? The matchmaker drops you into a live chameleon party game in seconds.

🏆 CHAMELEON SURVIVAL TIPS
• Study the stage before you paint - every hide and seek map hides differently
• Match colors, lighting, and texture - not just the obvious hue
• Pick a pose that fits the prop - a perfect statue is the best disguise
• Move only when you must - a frozen chameleon is a hidden chameleon
• Watch how other hiders fail - and don't repeat their mistakes

🌍 FEATURES
• Online hide and seek multiplayer for 2-10 players
• Public and private rooms with simple host controls
• Multiple stages, each packed with chameleon hiding opportunities
• Smooth mobile paint controls
• Regular updates, new maps, and seasonal party game events

Whether you're a chameleon with a paintbrush, a Seeker with sharp eyes - Hide & Seek: Chameleon is hide and seek like you've never played.

Download now. Paint yourself. Hide well. The Seekers are coming!

Pikët grumbullohen gjatë gjithë lojës dhe pasqyrojnë aftësinë e lojtarit për të kaluar pengesat me saktësi. Rekordi personal ruhet automatikisht dhe përditësohet menjëherë kur arrihet një rezultat më i mirë, duke motivuar për përmirësim të vazhdueshëm.

melbet përdor një sistem progresiv ku çdo sektor bëhet më sfidues se i mëparshmi. Numri i rrezeve rritet, ciklet bëhen më të shpejta dhe koha për të reaguar zvogëlohet gradualisht. Rrezet ndryshojnë gjendje me tranzicione të buta, ndërsa bërthama kryesore pulson vazhdimisht dhe reagon ndaj lëvizjeve të lojtarit. Efektet vizuale të kalimit të pengesave, goditjeve dhe përfundimit të sektorëve e bëjnë përvojën edhe më tërheqëse.

🔄 Riluajtshmëri e lartë

Falë ritmit progresiv, cikleve të ndryshme të rrezeve dhe kombinimeve të sektorëve, çdo lojë zhvillohet ndryshe. Kjo e bën melbet tërheqës edhe pas shumë sesioneve dhe nxit rikthimin për të vendosur rekorde të reja.

🥇 Rekordi personal

Rezultati më i mirë ruhet automatikisht dhe mbetet gjithmonë i disponueshëm. Çdo lojë është një mundësi për të kaluar më shumë sektorë, për të shmangur më shumë pengesa dhe për të fituar më shumë pikë. Sistemi i rekordeve personale motivon zhvillimin e refleksit dhe koordinimit në çdo sesion.

Kontroll intuitiv me prekje

data.name: Target Hunt
data.description_full: Target Hunt is a strategic casual chase game combining target tracking and threat evasion gameplay. Different from pure dodging games, this game integrates dual core mechanisms of target pursuit and danger avoidance, bringing layered and strategic casual challenges for players. Each level sets specific movable targets and distributed environmental threats. Players need to observe target movement tracks in real time, adjust their moving routes flexibly, track and approach designated targets steadily, while avoiding all chasing obstacles and sudden environmental dangers. The game features diverse target movement modes, including fixed-path travel, random drifting and variable-speed movement, requiring players to formulate dynamic tracking strategies. Level maps cover open fields, maze terrains and barrier-filled spaces, with unique threat distribution rules for each scene type. The progressive difficulty gradient is reasonably designed. Basic levels feature stable target routes and sparse threats for novice adaptation and skill accumulation. Advanced levels add multi-target interference, fast variable-speed movement and dense sudden threats, testing players’ dual-task coordination and real-time strategic adjustment ability. The smooth and flexible control system supports free direction switching and rapid route adjustment, adapting to complex tracking and evasion demands. Clear visual distinction between targets and threats helps players quickly identify key operational clues. Players can summarize movement rules and optimize tracking strategies through repeated attempts, steadily improving operational proficiency. With level unlocking, more complex target modes and elaborate map layouts will be available. This strategic arcade game cultivates players’ real-time judgment and multi-task coordination ability, bringing fulfilling and diverse casual challenge fun

data.name: Your Happy Ant
data.description_full:
Your Happy Ant is a casual puzzle game where you command a tiny ant colony to sort and clear colorful cubes. Drop ant-filled boxes into slots, watch the workers march out, and guide each cube to its matching hole. Simple to pick up, tricky to master — every level is a fresh brain teaser.
Gameplay
Tap a box to place it into a slot, and your ant squad automatically springs into action. Each ant crawls along the board edge, finds a cube of its own color, picks it up, and carries it into the hole. Sort all the colors and clear the board to win. With only 5 slots available, every placement matters — one wrong move can block the entire trail. Plan ahead, free up space, and command your ants in the perfect order to solve each puzzle.
Core Features
- Ant-driven puzzle mechanic: Place boxes to release worker ants — they automatically match and carry cubes by color, bringing satisfying automatic clears.
- Strategic slot management: Only 5 slots per level — carefully decide which box goes where, or risk clogging the trail.
- Diverse pixel art themes: Unlock hundreds of lovely scenes featuring animals, fruits, flowers, castles, holidays, toys, and more.
- Handy power-up tools: Shuffle rearranges all remaining boxes, Grab lets you pick any box to instantly place it, and the Vacuum removes all cubes of one color at once.
- Progressive challenge: Levels start easy and gradually introduce hidden boxes, linked boxes, and trickier layouts to keep your brain engaged.
- Offline & timer-free: Play anytime, anywhere with no WiFi needed and absolutely no time pressure.
Why Choose This Game
- Stress-free relaxation: No countdown, no stress — just cute ants and calming music. Perfect for unwinding during a commute, before bed, or anytime you need a break.
- Simple yet deep: One-tap controls make it easy to start, while the slot management and hidden mechanics offer real strategic depth for those who want a challenge.
- For all ages: Adorable pixel art, friendly ant characters, and intuitive gameplay make it enjoyable for kids, casual players, and puzzle lovers alike.
Ready to lead your own ant colony? Download Your Happy Ant now and dive into hundreds of colorful puzzle levels. Command the ants, sort the cubes, and discover beautiful pixel art — one happy march at a time.

data.name: Aero Ascent
data.description_full:
Take flight in Aero Ascent, a high-octane tactical flight strategy game set in a dark cyber-industrial future!

Aero Ascent is not a traditional flight simulator. It is a strategic risk-management game where every millisecond counts. Pilot advanced fusion jets through treacherous aerospace, watch the flight multiplier soar, and make split-second tactical decisions to extract before your systems overload!

🚀 CORE GAMEPLAY & MECHANICS

The Multiplier Run: As you fly, your multiplier continuously climbs. The longer you survive, the higher your score and virtual rewards.

Dual System Management:

Heat: Keep an eye on your core temperature. Hitting 100% causes an immediate overload crash!

Integrity: Avoid collisions with cosmic debris and plasma gates. Letting your integrity drop to 0% means mission failure.

Tactical Evacuation: Reached your target? Execute an Extract to safely land, saving your earned stars and virtual resources. Out of options? Trigger an Abort to cut your losses early.

🎲 PRE-FLIGHT DICE MODULES

Before launch, roll three tactical module dice to determine your mission assets:

Thrust: Grants charges for your high-speed Boosts.

Barrier: Grants charges for your electromagnetic Shields.

Auto Evade: Passive utility to dodge unforeseen impacts.

Pre-Flight Prediction: Analyze and predict the dice roll outcomes before launch. Correct predictions reward your jet with extra flight advantages!

⚡ IN-FLIGHT ACTIONS & BRANCHING ROUTES

Boost vs. Shield: Use Boost to rapidly ramp up your multipliers at the cost of high thermal buildup, or deploy Shields to absorb incoming anomalies.

Branching Flight Paths: Choose your lane in real-time. Do you steer toward a "Cooling Station" to lower your heat, or risk the "Elite Aerospace" for massive multiplier bonuses?

Dynamic Space Events: Encounter cargo transporters, repair drones, and solar storms. Choose between Conservative or Risky maneuvers to resolve each event.

🌌 CONTENT & PROGRESSION

6 Unique Cybernetic Sectors: Conquer 60 challenging stages (10 levels per sector).

Star Rating Challenges: Earn up to 3 stars per stage by completing standard objectives, braving hazardous paths, and conquering Overrun challenges.

Hangar Upgrades: Unlock premium jet models and upgrade your Engine, Cooling, and Shielding modules using virtual resources.

100% Offline Experience: All progress is saved locally. Play anytime, anywhere, with zero internet requirement.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER & COMPLIANCE

Aero Ascent is intended for an adult audience (18+) for amusement purposes only.

This game operates purely on virtual, non-transferable in-game currency. It does not feature or offer real-money gambling, nor any opportunity to win real money or physical prizes.

Practice or success at virtual risk-management gaming does not imply future success at real-money gambling.

- Tap on the color block clusters on the top grid to release them.
- Watch them fall into the grind machine where they are crushed into tiny sensory cubes.
- The cubes travel down a moving conveyor loop system.
- Sort and pack the rolling cubes into the matching color boxes below to clear the jam before it overflows!

- Keep your eyes on the looping conveyor belt. Don't let the moving line get clogged up! Quick reflex and smart color sorting are key.

Can you keep up with the conveyor line and clear every puzzle level? Download Color Loop a product developed by iKame Games today and start your satisfying puzzle journey!

Clear countless fun levels, unfold the romantic mysteries hidden in the starry night, and unlock exclusive story chapters one after another. Featuring soothing match-3 mechanics and progressive level challenges, the game delivers an immersive emotional gaming experience, taking you on a delightful puzzle adventure filled with warmth and subtle suspense.
Classic Stacked Match-3 & Strategic Puzzle Gameplay
The core gameplay adopts the classic stacked match-3 mechanism. Match three identical blocks to eliminate layered tiles on the board. As you advance through levels, the layouts become more intricate and challenging, requiring careful observation and reasonable strategic planning to clear stages smoothly.
With ultra-easy controls and zero entry barriers, the game is suitable for players of all ages. It does not require fast hand speed or instant reflexes. Simply analyze block distribution and plan your moves in advance to win every level effortlessly and gain a strong sense of accomplishment.
Powerful In-Game Items for Smooth Gameplay
Three practical strategic items are available to help you overcome difficult levels and avoid getting stuck:
- Undo: Reverse your last move instantly to correct mistakes and adjust your puzzle-solving strategy.
- Remove: Eliminate any targeted block on the board to break deadlocks and tricky situations.
- Shuffle: Reset all blocks on the board to create new matching opportunities and clear tough stages easily.
Immersive Starlight Storyline & Exclusive Episodes
Enjoy a complete immersive storyline accompanied by cinematic dynamic cutscenes, bringing you a binge-worthy gaming experience. Every level breakthrough rewards you with generous gifts and brand-new story content.
Reach key level milestones to unlock exclusive cinematic episodes. Keep progressing to unlock full story chapters and explore the hidden secrets behind the beautiful starlight tale.
Embark on your starry adventure now! Explore all the hidden wonders and romantic secrets in Starlight Tales!

data.name: Pop Arrow
data.description_full:
Pop Arrow is all about one simple goal: make every arrow leave the board.
Each arrow can only move in the direction it faces. Tap an arrow when its path is open, and it will pop away. If the way is blocked, look for another arrow that can open the route.
Every tap changes the board. One cleared arrow may free the next one, and the right order can turn a crowded puzzle into a clean empty space.
Read the directions, plan your moves, and pop the arrows one by one. The challenge is not speed, but finding the smartest sequence.
Start with one arrow, open the next path, and clear the whole board with a perfect finish.
data.description_short: Clear the board by popping arrows in the perfect order.

data.name: Печать Демонов
data.description_full:

Проходите сюжетную кампанию, участвуйте в испытаниях, исследуйте подземелья, побеждайте могущественных боссов и открывайте новые главы истории Шести Миров.

Подбирайте героев по стихиям, классам и способностям. Используйте сильные стороны персонажей, создавайте эффективные сочетания навыков и находите слабости противников.

Улучшайте персонажей, создавайте снаряжение, открывайте новые способности и повышайте боевую мощь своей команды. Развитие героев открывает множество вариантов тактики и стратегии.

Вступайте в гильдии, участвуйте в совместных событиях, помогайте союзникам и покоряйте сложные испытания вместе с другими игроками.

data.name: Grid Fit
data.description_full:
Looking for a quiet way to sharpen your mind and unwind? Welcome to Grid Fit. This is a gentle spatial logic puzzle where every block reacts to your moves with its own expressive face. Your objective is simple: drag out rectangles based on the numbers on the grid and find the exact space each emotion needs to feel balanced.
✨ Why You Will Love Grid Fit
• Expressive, Reactive Blocks: The grid is alive with feelings! As you drag to form shapes, the faces inside react in real time. Watch them show worry when cramped, surprise when stretched too far, or calm satisfaction when given the correct space.

• Mind Bending Challenges: Start with simple shapes and advance to massive brain teasers. As you progress, you will encounter tricky obstacles like hidden numbers (?) and locked tiles (🔒) that require clever strategies to solve.

• Calming, Focused Gameplay: Designed with clean visuals and minimal interruptions. Sink into a steady, relaxing flow state as you work through each level at your own pace.

• Helpful Boosters: Stuck on a super hard level? Use the lightbulb hint to instantly reveal the perfect fit for a stubborn block and keep the fun going.

•A Low Pressure Environment: There are no stressful timers or harsh penalties. Take your time to analyze the grid, follow the clues, and let the board puzzle together naturally.

💡 How to Play
• Give Each Emotion its Space: The number on each face indicates exactly how many grid squares its rectangle must cover.
• Drag to Fit: Swipe to stretch the block into a square or rectangle.
• Establish Boundaries: Each shape must contain exactly one expressive face, and territories cannot overlap.
• Solve the Puzzle: When the entire grid is correctly filled with the right sized shapes, the board clears and rewards you with a screen of fully satisfied, happy faces!

🧠 Benefits of Playing
• Interactive Logic: The changing micro expressions of the blocks make solving numeric grids intuitive and visually engaging.
• Gentle Brain Training: Quietly exercises your spatial reasoning and logical deduction skills without overwhelming your mind.
• Satisfying Order: Experience the quiet satisfaction of turning a scattered grid of numbers into an organized, harmonious board of perfectly balanced expressions.

Grid Fit is a straightforward logic puzzle built for quiet moments. Easy to learn yet offering a steady mental workout, it is a soothing way to spend a few minutes a day bringing order to a world of colorful emotions.
Download today and find your flow!

data.name: Five Nights at Freddy's House
data.description_full:
You just landed a night security job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza — a place where kids come to eat, laugh, and watch animatronic robots perform all day long. Sounds easy enough, right?
Wrong.
Once the lights go down and the restaurant closes, those friendly animatronic characters start moving on their own. Nobody knows exactly why. Nobody wants to find out up close. That's where you come in.
Locked inside your small office from midnight to 6 AM, your only tools are a set of security cameras spread across the building and two heavy doors on either side of you. Watch the monitors. Track every animatronic. The moment one of them goes missing from their spot — that's when things get dangerous.
Here's the catch: you're running on limited power all night. Every camera check, every light flick, every door you close drains your electricity. Run out before 6 AM and the doors stop working. The lights go out. And you're sitting in the dark with whatever walked in.
Five nights. One office. Zero room for mistakes.
Freddy Fazbear, Bonnie, Chica, and Foxy are all watching the clock just like you are — except they're not waiting for their shift to end. Manage your power carefully, stay alert on the cameras, and maybe — just maybe — you'll make it through the night.
Can you survive all five nights at Freddy's?

Game highlights
Simple tap controls, easy for beginners to start playing instantly
Massive unique puzzle levels with gradual difficulty adjustment
Smooth prism visual effects and comfortable in-game animations
Full offline support; you can play without stable internet
Various bridge scene themes to switch for fresh gaming experience
Low-pressure gameplay without strict countdown timers
Game introduction
This lightweight matching game helps you kill time and exercise logical thinking. It fits short breaks, commutes and leisure moments, with no intense competitive pressure.

This game includes optional advertisements and voluntary in-app purchases for extra hints and decorative themes. All core puzzle levels are fully accessible without any purchases. No mandatory payment to progress in the game.
Download Prism Pair: Bridge Blast and experience relaxing prism matching puzzles whenever you want.
