data.name: Pupdoku
data.description_full:
PupDoku — A Colorful Logic Puzzle for Dog Lovers

Love Sudoku, brain teasers, and adorable pups? PupDoku is a relaxing logic puzzle game where every move matters.

Your goal is simple: find the correct place for every hidden pup while following the puzzle rules. It is easy to learn, satisfying to solve, and challenging enough to keep your brain active.

Simple Rules, Clever Puzzles

Each puzzle board is divided into colorful zones. Use logic and careful observation to determine where every pup belongs.

• Place exactly one pup in every row.
• Place exactly one pup in every column.
• Each colored zone must contain exactly one pup.
• Pups cannot touch each other, even diagonally.

Mark the spaces where a pup cannot be placed, narrow down the possibilities, and solve the board step by step. There is no need for random guessing—every puzzle has a logical solution.

**Choose How You Play

**Level Mode**
Complete carefully designed puzzles and take on more challenging boards as you progress.

**Daily Challenge**
Return every day for a fresh puzzle and keep your logic-solving streak alive.

**Surprise Me**
Jump straight into a random puzzle whenever you want a quick brain workout.

💡 **Stuck on a Puzzle?**

Use hints to discover the right move and continue solving without losing your progress. Hints are perfect for learning new strategies and overcoming difficult puzzles.

✨ **Why You’ll Love PupDoku**

• Relaxing and satisfying logic gameplay
• Cute pup-themed visuals
• Colorful puzzle boards
• Easy rules with increasing difficulty
• Daily puzzles and level-based challenges
• Helpful hints when you get stuck
• Quick puzzles for short breaks
• Brain training for focus, reasoning, and observation

PupDoku combines the familiar logic of Sudoku with colorful zones and an adorable dog-themed twist. Whether you want a relaxing puzzle before bed or a challenging brain teaser during the day, there is always another pup waiting to be found.

Can you find every pup without breaking the rules?

Download PupDoku and start solving today! 🐾

data.description_full: WispChasm is a vertical English word-guessing mobile game that centers on reading clues and distinguishing synonyms. In each round, players see a textual hint about a target word and select the correct answer from four options. A correct answer earns points and moves to the next question; three cumulative wrong answers end the round. As the score rises, clues gradually shift from full definitions to more vague descriptions, and distractors evolve from cross-category words to similar-looking or easily confused spellings within the same category, steadily increasing the challenge. The vocabulary covers multiple themes including fruits, animals, weather, nature, objects, food, colors, body parts, musical instruments, and places, balancing word memorization with quick judgment. The game supports pause and resume, restart, and high-score recording. Controls are intuitive, making it perfect for challenging consecutive correct streaks during short breaks.

In this relaxing 3D puzzle, a colorful stack of cubes sits in the middle of your screen. Your goal? Pick out the right colored cubes and send them flying into matching storage boxes above. Below the target boxes, you’ll find a row of temporary storage slots. If you accidentally tap a cube whose color isn’t currently needed, it won’t disappear – it lands in a storage slot. Later, when that color becomes a target again, the stored cubes automatically jump into the right box and help you progress. But slots are limited, so don’t fill them with random colors!

🧠 Smart Strategy for Success
Always prioritize the current target color – this keeps your storage slots free for emergencies. Use rotation and zoom to spot the easiest cubes to reach first. For blocked areas, long‑press to see through and plan your next moves. The fewer cubes you store, the smoother your run. Plan your taps wisely, and every level becomes a satisfying, stress‑free victory.

data.name: Emerald Flower
data.description_full:
Emerald Flower is a survival-RPG that tells the story of a child who lost everything in a war, where your choices lead to multiple different endings.
Gather materials from the environment using the crafting and inventory system to create useful items.
Choose how to treat the characters you meet and alter their fates.
Every character you encounter in this fallen civilization matters. From an old man offering advice to a janitor, everyone has a story to tell.

Experience this intimate yet brutal narrative in depth with 2D retro pixel art graphics.

Damlama Government Classified Archive Records: Emerald Flower Project
Biological Origin & Reproduction:
Emerald Flower (Stapelia Smaragdina) is a parasitic plant originating from the Homo Heidelbergensis era. This species utilizes mammals to reproduce. Its transmission strategy relies on attracting humans with its mesmerizing fragrance. When the host inhales the fragrance, microscopic seeds attach to the olfactory nerve and the host unknowingly leaves the area.

The seed penetrates the brain, feeding on glucose, and extends its roots to the brainstem. Microscopic nanofibers seep into synaptic gaps, taking control of the mammal's instincts. At the end of a roughly 2-week process, the subject feels the urge to feed four times more than normal and to remain unclothed.

Stages of Infection:
There is no point of return at this stage. The host must remain emotionally stable; sudden emotions such as fear or intense happiness trigger the flower. If the host remains stable, the flower spreads throughout the body. However, if activated before fully spreading, it constricts the Carotid Artery (Arteria Carotis), cutting off cerebral blood flow and killing the host. 3 hours after death, the flower blooms through the mouth and nose. It dies if it fails to find a new host within 1 week. If a living being approaches the corpse, the flower releases seeds into the air, restarting the cycle.

Should We Be Concerned?
Humanity brought this nightmare under control years ago, burning all known instances to extinction. Only a single seed is kept secured in a high-security laboratory. Every year, we commemorate the first week of August as "Emerald Flower Awareness Week."

Archive Revisions
** (Revision 1) 12/02/2018**
The final seed and genetic codes of Emerald Flower were lost in an attack on the laboratory. A reward of 15 Million Rayet will be paid to anyone providing information.

** (Revision 2) 04/08/2018**
The Alpu Government claimed responsibility for the theft. They announced that the flower's sap functions as a fuel source 20 times more efficient than petroleum. While the world celebrates an energy revolution, our government pressures Alpu over unethical experiments. However, the international community accuses us of merely trying to preserve our oil dominance.

** (Revision 3) 25/01/2020**
Our government took action and launched Operation Lightning on Alpu, destroying the laboratory. Documents were destroyed and specimens seized. However, hundreds of thousands of civilians perished in the resulting fires. The world condemns us.

** (Revision 4) 30/06/2020**
State representatives united at the "Damlama's Rope" congress to declare war against us. The Damlama Government is now officially at war with the entire world.

** (Revision 5) 02/01/2021**

data.name: Paint or Seek and Hide: Online
data.description_full:
Paint or Seek is a hide-and-seek action game where you can paint your character, blend into the environment, and avoid being discovered by Seekers. Play online with other players or enjoy the game offline in single-player mode without Wi-Fi. Choose your role, explore various maps, and use camouflage to hide in plain sight. Play as a Hider and blend into the environment like a chameleon, or become a Seeker and find every hidden player before the timer runs out.

PAINT YOUR CHARACTER AND HIDE
As a Hider, find the perfect hiding place and press the red Paint button to enter Paint Mode. Use the painting tools to change your character’s colors and match nearby walls, objects, patterns, and decorations. The better your camouflage, the harder it will be for Seekers to notice you. Hiding is not only about standing behind objects. Paint your character, become part of the map, and hide directly in front of your opponents.

USE AUTO PAINT
Use the Auto Paint button to quickly camouflage your character. Auto Paint uses the environment behind you to help your character match nearby colors and patterns. Stand in the right position, activate Auto Paint, and prepare your camouflage before the search begins. Choose your hiding place carefully, because even perfect camouflage will not help if a Seeker notices you moving.

PLAY PROP HUNT MODE
Discover Prop Hunt gameplay and use objects, decorations, walls, and other parts of the environment to your advantage. Find a clever hiding place, match your surroundings, and use camouflage to fool the Seekers. Stay hidden until the timer ends and prove that you have chosen the perfect spot.

PLAY AS A SEEKER
As a Seeker, your goal is to search the entire map and find all hidden players. Look carefully at walls, corners, objects, decorations, and unusual shapes. Hiders may be painted to match the environment and could be hiding directly in front of you. You have five minutes to find every Hider before the timer reaches zero.

SURVIVE AS A HIDER
As a Hider, you must remain hidden until the end of the match. Find a smart location, paint your character, stay quiet, and avoid attracting attention. Seekers will inspect every part of the map, so both positioning and camouflage are important. Survive until the countdown ends to win the round.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Join online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt matches with other players. Compete as a Hider or Seeker, discover new hiding strategies, and test whether your camouflage can fool real opponents. Play online with friends or join multiplayer matches with players from around the world.

OFFLINE SINGLE-PLAYER
No internet connection? Paint or Seek can also be played offline. Enjoy single-player gameplay without Wi-Fi, practice painting and camouflage, explore colorful maps, and play hide-and-seek against computer-controlled characters. Offline mode is perfect while traveling, when mobile data is unavailable, or whenever you want to play alone.

GAME FEATURES
• Online multiplayer hide-and-seek gameplay
• Offline single-player mode
• Play without Wi-Fi
• Props Hunt game mode
• Play as a Hider or Seeker
• Paint your own character
• Automatic camouflage with Auto Paint
• Colorful maps and hiding locations
• Fast five-minute matches
• Simple mobile painting controls
• Action, survival, and party-game mechanics
• Play with friends and other players
• Practice against computer-controlled opponents

PAINT, BLEND, HIDE, AND SEEK!

Paint your character, match the environment, and hide in plain sight. Create the perfect camouflage and survive like a chameleon, or become a Seeker and find every hidden player before time runs out.

Download Paint or Seek and play online or offline today!

data.name: Captain Smash
data.description_full:
Captain Smash is a bossy orange pirate cat with one rule on his ship: nothing stays standing. See that stack of crates, barrels, and jars piled up on his deck? He wants it gone, and he's handing you the cannon to do it.

Here's how it works. Tap to fire, and knock the whole pile down. One finger, easy to pick up whenever you've got a minute. You only get so many cannonballs each level, so you can't just blast away. Every stack has to come down before you run out, which turns each level into a fun little puzzle.

The best part is what happens when stuff breaks. Wood splinters, ice cracks and shatters, stone chips off, and jars burst in a splash of color across the sand. Every shot is satisfying, and you'll want to line up the next one right away.

The Captain isn't out there alone. He's got a wide-eyed black crew cat who isn't so sure about all this, and a little blue bird who won't stop chirping. You fire, they cheer, and the Captain takes the credit.

Levels get trickier as you go, with tighter angles and tougher bonus rounds when you want a real challenge. Earn coins along the way and grab boosters for the piles that just won't budge.

• One finger — tap to fire
• Knock down crates, barrels, cans, jars, and blocks
• Wood, ice, stone, and glass each break their own way
• Captain Smash, his crew cat, and a little blue bird
• Coins and boosters for the stubborn stacks
• Trickier levels and harder bonus rounds

Free smash game. The Captain's deck is a mess — grab the cannon and smash it clean.

data.name: VectorVoid: CubeNull
data.description_full:
Welcome to VectorVoid: CubeNull. Six faces. A web of arrows. One rule that changes everything: an arrow can only fall when its path ahead is clear. Step by step, line by line, unravel the tangle across every face of the cube until nothing remains. It looks simple — until you realize every move you make ripples across the entire cube.
What Makes VectorVoid: CubeNull Special:
A Puzzle of Pure Sequence This is not about speed or reflexes. Every arrow on the cube is locked behind another arrow's path. The only way out is forward: find the arrow with a clear trail, remove it, and watch as new paths open across the cube. Every decision is a thread in a larger web. One wrong move and the whole puzzle locks up — forcing you to rethink everything from the beginning.
Six Faces, One Connected Challenge The arrows aren't isolated on individual faces — they cross edges, connect surfaces, and weave the entire cube into a single inseparable puzzle. Rotate the cube, inspect every angle, trace each line from end to end. The solution lives not on one face, but across all six. You're not solving a surface. You're solving a volume.
Where Logic Meets Spatial Intuition VectorVoid: CubeNull trains two parts of your brain at once. You need cold logic to reason through the sequence of removals: if this arrow falls, which path opens next? And you need spatial intuition to track lines across edges and around corners, holding the full 3D picture in your mind. Every level is a workout for both.
Minimalist Design, Maximum Focus Clean lines. Soft colors. No flashing effects, no timers, no pressure. The cube sits at the center of a calm, fog-shrouded space — just you, the arrows, and the puzzle. Every visual decision is made to keep you in a focused, meditative state. The only sound is the satisfying click of an arrow being cleared from the surface.
VectorVoid: CubeNull is for you if:
You love logic puzzles that reward patience over speed.
You enjoy the quiet satisfaction of untangling something complex one step at a time.
You want a game that challenges both your analytical mind and your spatial imagination.
You need a calm, beautiful space to clear your head while keeping your brain engaged.
The cube is waiting. Are you ready to clear it?
data.description_short: Clear the path, remove the arrows, conquer the cube.

data.name: Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles
data.description_full:
Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles brings together two beloved formats: jigsaw-style picture assembly and tile-matching strategy. The result is a puzzle that feels both familiar and entirely new. If you enjoy jigsaw puzzles, solitaire puzzles, or block-style puzzles, this one belongs on your device.

What Makes This Puzzle Different?

Most jigsaw puzzles are static. You open a box, sort pieces, and work toward a fixed image. This puzzle flips that model. Instead of a flat board, you face a vertical grid where tiles fall from above. Merge matching tiles to complete sections of a picture. Each completed section clears, and new tiles drop in. The puzzle keeps evolving with every move.

This falling mechanic turns every session into a living puzzle. You are not just assembling — you are managing, anticipating, and adapting. It is a puzzle that rewards careful thought without punishing hesitation. No timers, no lives, no pressure. Just you and the puzzle.

🧠 How to Play This Puzzle

● Find the matching tiles, slide and merge them.
● Strategically move tiles on the board based on which pieces are about to drop next
● Complete all sections to finish the current jigsaw puzzle
● Experience the satisfying payoff of solving each puzzle from start to finish

❤️ WHY PLAY Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles?

This puzzle never repeats itself. The falling order changes every time, so no two puzzle sessions feel the same. Whether you have two minutes or two hours, you can jump into a puzzle and make real progress.

For solitaire puzzle fans, the strategy adds depth. You are not matching randomly. You decide which sections to complete first and how to let new tiles fall. It is a puzzle that asks you to think ahead.

For block puzzle players, space management feels instinctive. Keeping the board clear is half the battle. Every merge buys you room. It is a puzzle of balance and foresight.

💪 Puzzle Collection That Grows With You

This puzzle game offers a wide variety of scenes. Nature puzzles, animal puzzles, art puzzles, and abstract puzzles are all included. Each puzzle you complete unlocks the next, so there is always a new puzzle waiting.

Difficulty scales gradually. Early puzzles give more room and simpler patterns. Later puzzles tighten the grid. But the core puzzle mechanics stay the same, so you never feel lost — you just get better at solving each puzzle.

🔥 Key Features of This Puzzle Game

● Unique falling tile puzzle blending jigsaw and solitaire
● Hundreds of HD jigsaw puzzles across multiple themes
● No timers, no stress — every puzzle at your own speed
● Satisfying clears and smooth animations for each puzzle
● Daily puzzle updates to keep things fresh
● Block-puzzle style space management adds strategic depth
● Perfect for quick puzzle sessions or longer play
● Regular additions to the puzzle library
● Intuitive touch controls designed for mobile puzzle games

⭐ Start Your Puzzle Journey Today

data.name: Stacktopia
data.description_full:
🧲 One simple rule, infinite variety
Every level gives you pairs of matching colors. Your job is to link each pair with a continuous line. The only condition: lines must remain independent. Touching or overlapping is not permitted.

⚡ Logic over speed
There is no clock. No rush. Each puzzle is a quiet conversation between you and the grid. Experiment with different orders. Undo freely. Restart when needed. The correct sequence always exists — you just have to find it.

📐 From open boards to tight mazes
Early stages offer plenty of room. Later, spaces shrink, colors multiply, and obstacles appear. You will learn to read the board differently — spotting bottlenecks, anticipating blockages, and leaving room for later connections.

🎨 Visual clarity, tactile response
Each color stands out clearly. Drawing feels fluid and responsive. Every successful match triggers a gentle confirmation, making progress satisfying without being distracting.

🧘 A calm mental workout
This is not about memory or reaction time. It is about observation, patience, and forward thinking. Each solved level leaves you sharper and more relaxed — a rare combination.

📦 What is inside

Dozens of difficulty tiers

Unlimited undos and resets

Clean, glare-free backgrounds for long sessions

Works entirely offline

🕹️ Play your way
Finish a few grids while waiting in line. Or sit down and work through a whole chapter. The difficulty scales naturally, so you never hit a sudden wall — but you will always feel the stretch.

🔗 Are you up for it?
Download today. Match every color, keep every line separate, and clear the board. One rule. Many solutions. Only one works.

data.name: Observatory Screwpuzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Observatory Screwpuzzle, a celestial and awe inspiring puzzle game that blends screw matching with the wonder of the night sky and the quiet majesty of a hilltop observatory. Your mission is to remove screws from colorful blocks by matching three screws of the same color. Each successful match clears the tile underneath, gradually revealing a breathtaking observatory scene filled with a towering dome telescope, star charts, a glowing night sky, distant planets, twinkling constellations, and perhaps even a shooting star streaking across the heavens. Clear all screws to complete each level and fully uncover the cosmic beauty of the observatory.

How to Play

Tap on a screw to select it, then tap on another screw of the same color to match them.

Match three screws of the same color in a row to clear a tile underneath.

Continue matching and clearing all tiles to reveal the complete observatory scene.

Clear all screws on the board to complete the level and unlock the next one.

Game Features
The game includes hundreds of levels with a steady and celestial difficulty curve. As you progress, you will encounter new screw colors, special tiles, and more intricate patterns that require careful observation and strategic planning. Each move must be thought through, as limited moves and complex layouts add a satisfying layer of challenge. The observatory themed design with deep space blues, starry silvers, warm golden telescope tones, and soft celestial glows creates a mesmerizing atmosphere that feels like gazing into the universe. The game also offers helpful boosters like the Telescope Wrench to remove any single screw, the Star Swap to change a screw's color, or the Observatory Shuffle to rearrange all screws for a fresh start. These features ensure that players of all ages and skill levels can enjoy the game without frustration. Play offline anytime, no WiFi needed.

Why You'll Love It
Observatory Screwpuzzle is the perfect way to explore the wonders of the cosmos while enjoying a satisfying puzzle challenge. It offers a calming yet mentally engaging experience that sharpens your logic and concentration while surrounding you with the breathtaking beauty of the night sky. The gentle cosmic sounds and starry, luminous visuals make every level feel like a peaceful journey through the stars. Whether you have a few minutes or a few hours, this game adapts to your pace, making it ideal for quick celestial breaks or long, immersive sessions.

Download Now
Download Observatory Screwpuzzle now and let the stars guide you to order and discovery!

data.name: Bộ Lạc 3Q
data.description_full:
Bộ Lạc 3Q là một tựa game Tam Quốc chắc chắn sẽ làm dậy sóng cho cộng đồng game thủ tại Việt Nam, khi tái hiện thế giới quen thuộc theo phong cách nguyên thủy đầy mới lạ. Dàn thần tướng được tạo hình nhí nhố nhưng vẫn rất cá tính, khoác lên mình những bộ chầy khố độc đáo. Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm một tựa game giải trí độc nhất vô nhị, đây chính là ứng cử viên sáng giá.
⁕⁕⁕ TÍNH NĂNG ĐẶC SẮC⁕⁕⁕
1. Tam Quốc Đồ Đá – Đập Nhau Thấy Đã
Bộ Lạc 3Q quy tụ dàn danh tướng quen thuộc, nay được tái sinh trong hình hài nguyên thủy đầy mới mẻ. Không chỉ combat căng đét bằng những vũ khí được tạo bằng đá còn có các gậy gộc và cung nỏ đều được sử dụng để chiến đấu, kết hợp cùng đồ họa đẹp mắt mang đến cho người chơi trải nghiệm thích thú về một thế giới Tam Quốc bí ẩn.

2. Tặng 1000 Lượt Chiêu Mộ - Phúc Lợi Khổng Lồ
Mỗi ngày đăng nhập là được tặng nhẹ 1000 lượt chiêu mộ, say mê quay tướng thoải mái, không cần nghĩ nhiều. Cơ hội sở hữu những cái tên xịn sò như Gia Cát Lượng, Trương Phi trở nên dễ dàng hơn bao giờ hết với tỷ lệ ra tướng cực kỳ hấp dẫn. Dù là người chơi muốn cày chay, vẫn có thể thu thập được đủ các danh tướng cực mạnh, từ đó xây dựng đội hình ngon lành.
3. Tạo Hình Ngáo Ngơ – Chơi Vui Bất Ngờ
Hệ thống nhân vật được chia thành bốn phe Ngụy, Thục, Ngô và Quần Hùng, mỗi tướng đều có tạo hình và biểu cảm rất riêng, vừa sinh động vừa có chút ngáo ngơ duyên dáng. Từ những khoảnh khắc vui nhộn trong trận đấu đến phong cách chiến đấu khác biệt. Hãy chiêu mộ ngay và bố trí đội hình chiến đấu độc đáo, sẵn sàng đóng khố cầm chầy quẩy tung chiến trường.
4. Kỹ Năng Tấu Hài – Anh Tài Combat
Kỹ năng chiến đấu của các anh tài có một không hai, mỗi lần tung chiêu là một lần khiến người chơi bật cười. Mỗi danh tướng đảm nhận một vai trò rõ ràng: người mở đường cầm cung, kẻ bày mưu cầm quạt... phối hợp nhịp nhàng trong đội hình 5vs5, kết hợp tung chiêu nhanh nhẹn từ các anh tài, để tạo ra vô số màn combat rất riêng và không đụng hàng.

5. Xây Dựng Bộ Tộc – Cầm Gậy Gộc Quất Thiên Hạ
Tự tay xây dựng bộ tộc của riêng mình, và bắt đầu hành trình đánh đâu thắng đó. Từ những trận PvP liên server như Tranh Bá Cửu Châu căng thẳng, đến hoạt động PvE hào hứng. Vừa phát triển bộ tộc ngày càng mạnh, vừa chiến đấu với gậy gộc thôi cũng đủ tạo nên những trận chiến đáng nhớ.

KPSS 2026'ya hazırlanan lisans, önlisans ve ortaöğretim adayları; üniversite öğrencileri, yeni mezunlar ve genel kültürünü test etmek isteyen herkes için. İster otobüste, ister derste molanda, ister akşam tekrarında — birkaç dakikada bir maç çöz, küçük tekrarlarla büyük fark yarat.

Klasik soru bankalarını tek başına çözmek çoğu zaman zorlu ve sıkıcıdır. Biz öğrenmeyi oyunlaştırdık: rekabet, hız ve anlık geri bildirim sayesinde sorular akılda daha kolay kalır. data.name: Dig Gold
data.description_full:
1. Game Overview
Gold Miner is a classic casual arcade puzzle mobile game suitable for players of all ages. Launched for mainstream mobile platforms including Android and iOS, this single-player free-to-play game has won global popularity with its simple operation, addictive gameplay and relaxing gaming experience. With bright, colorful and user-friendly graphic design, the game creates a casual mining atmosphere, allowing players to enjoy easy and fun mining adventures anytime and anywhere, whether online or offline. The core goal of the game is to collect sufficient treasures within the limited time of each level to reach the target score and unlock more challenging stages.
2. Core Gameplay & Operation Guide
The game features extremely intuitive one-touch mobile operations with zero learning threshold. Players control a swinging mining hook fixed at the top of the screen, which automatically swings left and right steadily. By simply tapping the mobile screen at the right moment, you can release the hook, which will drill straight down into the underground mine to grab various buried items. After capturing objects, the hook will automatically retract to deliver the loot.
Each level is time-limited. Players must strategically grab valuable items and accumulate enough gold value to meet the level’s target quota before the countdown ends. Failing to reach the target within the time limit means failing the level and requires a retry. As players advance, the swinging speed of the hook changes subtly, and the distribution of underground items becomes more complex, greatly testing players’ timing judgment and on-the-spot reaction ability.
3. In-Game Items & Treasures
The underground mine is filled with diverse items with different values, weights and recycling speeds, which determine the player’s mining strategy:
- Gold Nuggets: The most basic core treasure. Available in multiple sizes—small gold pieces with low value and light weight, and large gold blocks with high profits but heavier weight and slower retraction speed. They are the main source of level score.
- Diamonds: High-value rare treasures. Though small in size and hard to target accurately, diamonds are lightweight, retract extremely fast, and bring considerable profits (over 600 points each), making them the top priority for high-efficiency mining.
- Mystery Bags: Random loot bags hidden in the mine. They contain random rewards, including extra cash, powerful props, or occasional trivial items, bringing unexpected surprises to each mining attempt.
- Rocks: Low-value obstacles. They are extremely heavy, take a long time to retract, and barely contribute to the score. It is recommended to avoid grabbing rocks in conventional situations to save time for valuable treasures.
4. Functional Power-Ups & Props
To help players pass difficult levels, the game provides a variety of practical power-up props that can be obtained through level rewards or in-game collection:
- TNT Dynamite: A classic practical prop. When grabbed together with useless rocks or redundant items, it can instantly blow up unwanted obstacles, save retraction time, and clear mining obstacles.
- Strength Potion: Greatly improves the hook’s traction and retraction speed, allowing players to quickly pull up heavy large gold blocks and rocks, effectively improving mining efficiency.
- Value Bonus Props: Increase the profit of grabbed items, enable low-value items to generate more coins, and help players easily reach the level target.
data.description_short: Get ready to embark on an exciting gold rush adventure.

Khám phá thế giới Pokémon và tiếp tục hành trình trở thành Bậc thầy!

【Công nghệ mô hình 3D cho trải nghiệm sống động】 Mỗi Pokémon được tái tạo tỉ mỉ qua mô hình 3D độ chính xác cao, từ vẻ ngoài đáng yêu của Pikachu đến sự hiện diện uy nghi của Charizard. Hiệu ứng kỹ năng độc quyền vô cùng ấn tượng, với những tia chớp và ngọn lửa rực cháy tạo nên trải nghiệm trực quan mạnh mẽ. Hơn nữa, các kỹ năng tương tác với môi trường trong thời gian thực—lửa trong cỏ, điện trên mặt nước—tạo nên trải nghiệm thực sự sống động!

【Sự lựa chọn của bạn định hình nên một hành trình độc đáo】 Pokémon không chỉ là lực lượng chiến đấu của bạn mà còn là người đồng hành cùng bạn trưởng thành. Sự tương tác sâu sắc và huấn luyện cá nhân hóa làm cho mỗi Pokémon trở nên độc đáo. Căn cứ, đội hình và chiến thuật của bạn cùng nhau viết nên câu chuyện Huấn luyện viên độc đáo của bạn.

【Lối chơi thông minh, trải nghiệm niềm vui qua chiến thuật】 Hãy tạm biệt việc chỉ tập trung tăng chỉ số một cách mù quáng! Hiểu rõ mối quan hệ giữa các thuộc tính, kỹ năng và đội hình; tận dụng môi trường và chiến lược để giành chiến thắng. Trong các thử thách PVE và trận chiến đấu trường, mỗi chiến thắng là minh chứng cho cả trí tuệ và sự gắn kết.

【Lối chơi xây dựng căn cứ: Tạo nên một ngôi nhà Pokémon ấm cúng】 Lối chơi xây dựng căn cứ SLG sáng tạo cho phép bạn tự do đặt các công trình như Trung tâm Hồi phục Pokémon và Vườn Cây Năng Lượng. Bố cục cân bằng giữa tính thẩm mỹ và hiệu quả; các sự kết hợp chiến lược giúp tăng tốc độ hồi phục của Pokémon và tăng tốc thu kinh nghiệm, cho phép bạn tạo ra căn cứ độc đáo của mình.

Thế giới đã sẵn sàng, câu chuyện đang chờ đợi sự khởi đầu. Giờ thì hãy ném Poké Ball và hét lên: Ta chọn ngươi!

Color Sort Solitaire is a clean and engaging card game experience that combines color logic, visual sorting, and card-based strategy into a relaxing yet thoughtful puzzle. Designed for players who enjoy mind games, word games, logic puzzles, and wisely designed solitaire games, this experience turns colors into the core rule that drives every move while encouraging strategic thinking.

Each level presents a structured board filled with cards that may show numbers, letters, shapes, or objects. While their symbols vary — echoing the variety found in word puzzle and association-based games — every card follows one simple rule: color defines belonging.

Your task is to activate a color category and carefully guide each card to where it belongs. While the symbols on the cards may change, their visual identity remains the same. Mastery comes from observing the board, spotting connections, understanding how elements are associated, and thinking several moves ahead.

This is not a speed game. Every decision matters. Moves are limited, paths can block each other, and the board evolves as you play. The challenge grows from observation and foresight rather than memorization, offering a challenging yet rewarding experience inspired by the calm focus of a solstice moment.

- Use your available moves efficiently and strategically

❌ When the game ends

Play at your own pace, enjoy the clarity of visual rules, and relax with a puzzle that stays thoughtful without becoming overwhelming. data.name: 幻想水滸伝 STAR LEAP
data.description_full:
◆本作の特徴◆
■出会いが物語を動かす——仲間と紡ぐ群像劇
世界を廻り、108星をはじめ多くのキャラクターとの出会いによって紡がれる物語。
仲間が増えるほど、冒険は広がり、物語の表情も豊かに描かれていきます。

■“奥行きのあるドット表現”で描かれる冒険世界
キャラクターもロケーションも、奥行きのあるドット表現で描写。
懐かしくも新しいRPGとしての体験が楽しめます。

■仲間の数だけ広がる、戦略とバトル体験
本作はタイムラインターンバトルを採用し、
仲間の組み合わせが、戦術の幅を広げていきます。
バトルでは通常戦闘に加えて、「幻想水滸伝」シリーズならではの戦争モードも実装。

◆ストーリー◆
世界を創造したとされる27ある真の紋章
“変化の紋章”はそのうちの1つ
時は、太陽暦453年。 赤月帝国の東にある湖畔の里に、突如惨劇が訪れた。
謎の敵の襲撃。炎に包まれる家々。逃げ惑う人々。
脅威が去った後、主人公は、ヒスイ、シーリーン、シャプールと共に里の復興を決意する。
その旅路で、主人公たちは歴史の大きなうねりに巻き込まれていくのであった。
人々を苦しめる帝国の非道とは何か。 ビクトール、フリック、オデッサ…… 様々な人物との出会いが導く運命とは何か。
小さな冒険は、やがて大きな志へと変化していく。

”ただ、一人のために”

■ メインキャラクターデザイン：もりょ

【『幻想水滸伝 STAR LEAP』はこんな方にオススメ！】
・古き良きオーソドックスなRPGを遊びたい
・王道を捉えたRPGを遊びたい
・じっくり本格RPGを遊びたい
・普段からドット絵で表現されたRPGでよく遊ぶ
・重厚なストーリーを体験したい
・味方や敵の信念がぶつかり合う物語が好き
・子供のころに遊んでいたドットRPGが好き
・レトロなRPG体験を味わいたい
・クラシックなRPGを遊びたい
・シンプルな操作で本格的なバトルを楽しみたい
・リッチなドット表現で描かれたキャラクターのバトルが楽しめるRPGをプレイしたい
・ターン性のコマンドバトルが好き
・戦略によって強敵にも勝てるようなバトルが好き
・爽快感のあるバトルを楽しみたい
・たくさんキャラクターや豊富な種族が登場するRPGをプレイしたい
・複雑に作り込まれた設定でストーリーの考察が楽しめるRPGを探している
・やりこみ要素のあるRPGをプレイしたい
・夢中になれるRPGを探している

data.name: Гиперион X
data.description_full:
Исследуй измененный мир Гиперион и открой для себя великие перемены! Жизнь никогда не станет прежней. Небо закрыл туман, звери обрели крылья, а города отодвинулись друг от друга… Отголоски древней войны настигли нас. Девять Звезд явили знак: настало время Великого созидания и героических битв.

Живи в мутировавшем мире, сражайся с межзвездными рыцарями и верни планете былое величие. Настал твой час войти в Гиперион!

- Герои

Выбирайте класс персонажа, а вместе с ним - боевой стиль, навыки и внешность.
Мечник — лучший танк в Галактике! Выбирай, если ценишь крепких ребят.
Ронин — живой ураган на поле боя Гипериона! Выбирай, если тебе нужен головокружительный крит.
Маг — молния в центре бури Гипериона! Выбирай, если хочешь парализовать врага и усилить союзников.
Лучник — тихая (или не очень) смерть с первого выстрела! Выбирай, чтобы враг умирал раньше, чем поймет почему.

- Экипировка

Множество вариантов оружия - красиво и смертоносно! Тебя ждут артефакты и камни души, крылья, святые мощи, тайное оружие и многое другое! Всё для ослабления противника и усиления себя любимого!

- Кастомизация на любой вкус

Одежда, не только красивая, но и увеличивающая твои параметры. Аватары, чтобы тебя никогда не перепутали с кем-то другим, и рамки для них. Облачка текста, звания, и много чего ещё.

- Всё для быстрого развития

Игровые механики на любой вкус - сражения с боссами и другими игроками, подземелья, битвы на арене, крафт, задания гильдий и даже парусная романтика. Одних только боссов не перечесть. Вас ждут сражения между игроками, а также битвы гильдий и даже целых серверов! Для дропа - рулетки и захватывающие ивенты, для приключений - мрачные подземелья, для созидания - мощный крафт, для коллекционеров - уникальный архив. Точно не соскучитесь!

- Воплощения

Выбирай Воплощения на высоких уровнях, чтобы стать ещё сильнее и сочетать способности разных классов в одном персонаже! С механикой воплощений лучник сможет почувствовать себя воином или даже магом. Головокружительные сочетания откроют новые возможности!
Также будут доступны два поистине непобедимых сабкласса (а ещё эти сабклассы невероятно красивы!)

- Невероятные ивенты

Расписание на неделю будет плотным! Банкет гильдии и работа в Шахте, подъем по этажам Обелиска и безжалостная война Афритов, ежедневная Арена и гильдейская Одиссея… Всего не перечислишь, но все сражения - за добро против зла.

- Новые знакомства

Объединяйтесь в кланы, общайтесь в личных сообщениях или общих чатах, найдите новых друзей и побеждайте врагов еще успешнее! Общие завоевания сплотят вас в межсерверных битвах, хранилище снаряжения позволит обменяться вещами, а гильдейские усиления сделают вас непобедимым. И, конечно, множество разнообразных активностей гильдии не даст заскучать!

- Многоуровневая система достижений и рейтингов

Ты никогда не устанешь развиваться и стремиться к цели!

- Прекрасная графика

Невероятный мир заворожит и не отпустит, заставляя вновь и вновь возвращаться!

До встречи в Гиперионе!

data.name: シンプル戦国
data.description_full:
ざわめく現代都市に、戦国の豪傑たちが静かに姿を現した——
『シンプル戦国』は、派手な立ち絵を排し、戦国の本質に立ち返った放置育成ゲーム。魅力的なストーリーで、武将たちと共に歩む日常にラクラク没入できる。
信長と肩を並べて戦い、信玄と共に策を練る——そんな夢を叶えてみないか？豪傑たちと出会い、道を共にし、あなただけの戦国絵巻を描こう！
【ワンタップで天下人】——放置するだけで名を上げる
両手はもう自由！放置で経験値アップ、放置で成長加速。無名の一兵卒から天下人へ、ラクラク駆け上がろう！織田信長、武田信玄、上杉謙信などの戦国の豪傑を募集し、あなただけの戦国への旅に出よう！
【現世の奇修行】——戦国を身をもって体感
武将たちのグループチャットに参加し、戦国からタイムスリップしてきた豪傑たちが現代でどう生きるかを間近で見届けよう。水墨画タッチのアートとチャット形式で、唯一無二の戦国日常を体験できる！
【諸国漫遊記】——知略で秘宝を奪取
手配書を受けて強敵を討伐し、諸国を漫游して伝説の遺跡を探索しよう！失われた秘伝書、貴重な名武具、誰にも語られなかった秘聞——すべては旅の果てに待っている！
【一門繁栄】——家臣と共に覇業を謀る
天守閣を踏破し、武道大会で名を馳せ、武将たちの気高さを示せ！一門を創り、名山を争い、豊富な育成リソースを獲得しよう！剣豪との合戦、武将同士の手合せ、天登の争覇——そして家臣と共に覇業を築き上げろ！「放置」≠「ソロ」、オンラインプレイヤーとのリアルタイム交流で、共に頂点を争え！

data.name: Gorilla Tag

Gorilla Tag puts you inside a gorilla's body. No buttons, no sticks, no shortcuts. You move by pushing and grabbing real surfaces with your hands and arms, and every chase, every escape, and every leap feels like something you actually earned.

A locomotion system unlike anything else. Push off walls to launch yourself across a canyon. Squeeze branches with both hands to climb. Grab a rope and swing through a cave. Every movement type was designed around what feels satisfying to your arms, not what's easy to code.

Content that never stops. The game updates every two weeks. Ropes, ziplines, hang gliders, hoverboards, swimming and more have all been added since launch, spread across environments from a sunlit forest to underground cave systems to open sky. You will not run out of things to do.

A creator community that feeds the game. Share My Blocks and Virtual Stump give players the tools to build and publish their own maps. The result is a stream of new worlds built by people who actually play the game. Some of the most played spaces in Gorilla Tag today were made by the community, not the studio.

Modes for every kind of player. Whether you want casual minigames with friends or a serious ranked climb, there is a place for you. Experimental limited-time modes like Guardian and Ghost Reactor show up regularly and push the game somewhere unexpected.

Tag someone and make them join your team, or run until your arms burn and somehow survive another round. Welcome to the chaos.

Reject humanity. Become monkey.

Relaxed Mind Mode — A dedicated mode that gently engages your focus, planning, and memory without ever overloading them.

Classic Mahjong Solitaire — Hundreds of carefully designed boards in the timeless tile-matching style you know and love.

Super Combo — Chain matches to unlock soothing visual effects that reward your flow, not your speed.

No Timer, No Pressure — Think at your own pace. No score chasing. No stress. Just you and the tiles.

Helpful Companions — Free hints, undo, and shuffle whenever you need a gentle nudge or a fresh perspective on the board.

Daily Calm Challenge — A new mahjong puzzle every day. A small daily moment to pause and reset.

Offline Mode — Full offline support. Enjoy your peaceful mahjong moments anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed.

Crisp, Clear Tile Art in a Relaxing Cartoon Style — Every tile is crafted with vivid clarity and charming, minimalist cartoon aesthetics. The soft visuals and clean, high-contrast designs make each symbol instantly readable, so you can focus entirely on the match — not on squinting at the screen.

data.name: Skyborne Survival
data.description_full:
The world below is lost. Humanity climbed into the sky generations ago, and now the floating cities are running dry. You inherit one aging flying base — and the choice of what to do with it.

BUILD YOUR SKY BASE

CRAFT & CUSTOMIZE AIRCRAFT
Aircraft are tools, not heroes. Assemble scouts, engineers, transports and fighters from interchangeable modules — engines, wings, tanks, radar and weapons. Every module shifts speed, range, cargo and weight, so loadouts are real decisions.

EXPLORE THE RUINS
Launch into vertical combat regions where your aircraft fires automatically while you dodge, pick targets and grab loot. Salvage resource crates, recover wrecked aircraft, uncover ancient relics and rescue survivors.

RISK VS REWARD
Fuel drains as you push deeper. Cargo holds fill up fast — keep the rare haul or dump weight to fly faster. When danger spikes, retreat, jettison cargo for a speed boost, or press your luck. Getting home alive is the real goal.

RESEARCH & PROGRESS
Tech comes from exploration, not grinding. Recover blueprints to unlock long-range wings, military engines and better radar. Level up pilots and crew with every mission. Reach farther regions, scale your industry, and slowly rebuild a sky civilization.

Plays fully offline. No ads, no tracking, no internet required after install. Your progress is saved on your device.

data.name: Destroy Shot
data.description_full:
Welcome to Destroy Shot. The cannon is your instrument, the arena your canvas, and every shot paints a picture of pure, unrelenting chaos. This isn't a game about careful nudges and gentle taps. This is about finding the one shot that tears through everything in its path. Every object in the arena — every jar, every crate, every stone fortress — is waiting for its final moment. Your job is simple: aim, fire, and erase it from existence.
What Makes Destroy Shot Special:
- The Art of Absolute Destruction Most games ask you to build or collect. Destroy Shot asks you to unmake. Each level presents a carefully constructed setup, and your job is simple in concept but deeply satisfying in practice: find the critical point and tear it all down. The physics engine ensures that every collision, every shatter, every collapse feels weighty and real. When you pull the trigger, the world responds with the full force of simulated destruction. There's nothing quite like watching a fortress crumble under the force of your single, perfectly aimed shot.
- Where Destruction Meets Celebration The arena is a festival turned spectacle. Colorful bunting stretches across crumbling walls. Lanterns sway as shockwaves ripple through the scene. The chaos is framed by celebration, making every explosion feel like a firework and every collapse feel like confetti falling. This is not violence for its own sake — it is destruction as theater, as performance, as the ultimate show.
- Precision That Rewards Mastery The controls are simple: aim, adjust power, fire. But mastering them is a journey. Understanding how different materials behave under impact, how objects interact in a chain, and how to read a setup for its critical weakness — this is the skill that separates a good shot from a legendary one. Every level teaches you something new, and every success feels earned.
Destroy Shot is for you if:
• You dream of the single perfect shot that changes everything.
• You find satisfaction in absolute, uncompromising destruction.
• You appreciate physics that feels real and weighty.
• You want a game that rewards precision but celebrates power.
• You believe that one well-placed shot is worth a hundred random ones.
Load the Cannon. Take Aim. Fire. Every level is a new setup waiting to be destroyed. Every shot is a new discovery. The arena is waiting for its grand finale — and you are the only one who can deliver it.
data.description_short: One shot to rule them all. Aim true, fire with intent, watch worlds fall.

data.name: Tikal Online
data.description_full:
Tikal: Kingdom of the Jade Serpent is a classic-style, top-down MMORPG set in an original Maya-inspired world of jungle temples, jade and obsidian, feathered serpents and deep, dangerous ruins. It captures the slow, tense adventure of the early-2000s online RPGs — with a look and a legend all its own.

Sail to the rookie isle of Sak Béu, clear your first cellar rats, then walk the ancient white causeways to the great maize-city of Yaxalún to choose your calling before the Three Faces of Heaven.

CHOOSE YOUR CALLING
- Jaguar Knight — the wall that holds the line, with heavy armor and obsidian blades.
- Eagle Paladin — master of spear, atlatl and bow, conjuring their own ammunition.
- Sky Sorcerer — devastating fire and lightning magic, fragile but deadly.
- Jade Druid — healer and nature-mage who mends allies and snares foes.

EXPLORE A LIVING KINGDOM
- Five city-states across jungle, swamp, mountain and canopy, bound by raised white sacbeob causeways.
- Cross wolf-haunted forests, troll caves, orc warcamps and sunken cenote-shrines.
- Descend into the flooded under-tunnels where the Gnawing Dark still stirs.

CLASSIC MMORPG GAMEPLAY
- Real-time, tile-based combat with tactical positioning.
- Loot, trade, bank your treasure, and grow your hero across levels and skills.
- Quest chains that teach the world and reward the brave.
- Share a persistent world with other players.

BUILT FOR MOBILE
- Portrait, touch-first controls designed for phones and tablets.
- Beautiful, hand-crafted procedural art — jade, gold, terracotta and limestone.
- Free to play.

The causeways are unsafe again. Wolves at the gates, trolls in the eastern cave, orcs massing in the north. A good season to carry a blade.

Answer the call of the Feathered Serpent. Your legend begins in Tikal.

data.name: Fishing Travel: Hook & Explore
data.description_full:
Fishing Travel: Hook & Explore — это лёгкая и атмосферная игра о рыбалке и исследованиях. Забрасывайте удочку в разных уголках мира: на тихих озёрах, бурных реках и в бескрайних морях. Каждая локация скрывает собственные виды рыб, и чтобы поймать редкие экземпляры, понадобятся мастерство и опыт.
Исследование и пейзажи
В игре вас ждут десятки уникальных точек для рыбалки — от уединённых природных уголков до оживлённых городских набережных. Открывайте новые места, любуйтесь красивыми видами и находите идеальные точки для поимки трофейной рыбы.
Стратегия и вызовы
Чем сложнее рыба — тем ценнее награда. Комбинируйте и улучшайте удилища, катушки и приманки, подбирая снаряжение под разные водоёмы и виды рыб. Соревнуйтесь с игроками со всего мира, доказывайте своё мастерство и выигрывайте ценные призы.
Строительство и отдых
За полученные награды вы сможете обустроить собственное уютное пространство: начните с простых украшений и постепенно превратите его в роскошный дом у воды. Расслабляйтесь, украшайте своё жилище и наслаждайтесь спокойной жизнью вдали от суеты. Регулярные ограниченные по времени события добавляют новые задания и свежие впечатления.
Пора забросить леску и отправиться в незабываемое рыболовное путешествие. Откройте мир Fishing Travel уже сегодня!

The puzzles start easy but gradually introduce more arrows, tighter layouts, and trickier configurations that will test your observation and planning skills. Every cleared level brings a moment of accomplishment and a chance to earn bonus rewards. 🚀

🟢 Colorful & Calming Design – Bright, cheerful arrows and a clean interface make every session relaxing and visually satisfying.

🧠 Brain-Friendly Challenge – Each puzzle trains your logic, planning, and focus without feeling overwhelming.

data.name: Uv666Ghostly
data.description_full: Uv666Ghostly is a vertical casual baking reaction game, centred around the core gameplay of 'collect the bread before it burns'. At the bottom of the screen is a cosy bread-dispensing area, where golden croissants keep popping up and floating towards the top of the screen. Players need to tap the bread quickly to collect it. Each piece of bread has a countdown ring around it, changing colour from green to yellow to red, clearly showing the remaining baking time. Clicking after the bread is burnt or letting it burn counts as a mistake, and three mistakes end the game. As your score increases, the bread appears more frequently, baking windows shorten, and the popping speed rises, with up to three pieces of bread appearing simultaneously, making the pace more intense. The game supports pause, restart, high score recording and vibration feedback. The rules are simple and easy to pick up, yet the continuous acceleration tests your focus and reaction skills, making it perfect for challenging yourself in short bursts.
data.description_short: Uv666Ghostly is a reactive baking mobile game

data.name: RayBar Ac
data.description_full: RayBar Ac is a portrait-mode endless-run mobile game. Its core mechanic involves controlling a sleek gliding body to dodge left and right within a constantly descending void channel. Players slide left or right to adjust position precisely, weaving through gaps between energy guardrails and diamond-shaped crystal barriers. Higher scores make the channel scroll faster, shortening reaction windows. Colliding with a barrier ends the run, and you can challenge your all-time high score. The controls are intuitive, the pace intensifies step by step, making it suitable for short sessions and repeated attempts to push the distance limit.

Crossfire: Legends, huyền thoại FPS vượt thời gian, cập nhật phiên bản 4.0!
Được phát triển tối ưu cho nền tảng di động, Crossfire: Legends mang đến nhịp độ chiến đấu kịch tính của bản PC huyền thoại — nay với thao tác điều khiển mượt mà, trực quan, sẵn sàng cho mọi cuộc giao tranh mọi lúc, mọi nơi.

C4 Kinh Tế & C4 Kinh Tế Tốc Độ
Đấu trường chiến thuật nơi mỗi quyết định đều ảnh hưởng đến cục diện trận đấu. Quản lý nguồn tiền qua từng vòng, lựa chọn vũ khí và trang bị phù hợp để tối ưu sức mạnh toàn đội. Phối hợp chiến thuật, kiểm soát kinh tế và tận dụng từng cơ hội để lật ngược thế trận, giành chiến thắng trong những màn đối đầu căng thẳng nhất.

Zombie Truy Kích – Di Tích Trên Không & Thế Giới Lập Phương
Cuộc đào thoát sinh tử qua 5 ải địa hình đầy thử thách trước làn sóng Zombie đang truy đuổi không ngừng. Phối hợp cùng đồng đội vượt chướng ngại vật, mở khóa các cơ chế bản đồ và cố thủ tại những điểm phòng thủ trọng yếu để cầm chân kẻ địch. Chỉ với tinh thần đồng đội và những pha phối hợp chính xác, cả đội mới có thể sống sót và chạm tới điểm thoát hiểm cuối cùng.

Mode Trốn Tìm (Hide and Seek)
Màn đấu trí căng thẳng giữa Thợ Săn và Phe Trốn. Biến hình thành những vật thể quen thuộc trong văn phòng để hòa mình vào môi trường và đánh lừa đối thủ. Trong khi đó, Thợ Săn phải vận dụng khả năng quan sát và phán đoán để truy tìm từng mục tiêu đang ẩn nấp. Liệu phe Trốn có thể cầm cự đến cuối cùng, hay sẽ bị quét sạch trước khi thời gian kết thúc?

Boss Thế Giới – Anh Em Quyền Ma
Thử thách sinh tồn luyện ngục khốc liệt nhất lịch sử! Đối đầu cặp Boss song sinh Lửa và Băng trong trận chiến đầy thử thách. Phối hợp cùng đồng đội né tránh những đòn tấn công hủy diệt, tìm ra điểm yếu của kẻ địch và tung ra hỏa lực tối đa để giành chiến thắng. Hạ gục Anh Em Quyền Ma để có cơ hội nhận được những vũ khí vĩnh viễn giá trị.

Chế Độ Đặt Bom C4 Kinh Điển
Chế độ C4 Phòng thủ vững chắc, tấn công bùng nổ. Một sai lầm nhỏ, cả team trả giá!
Trận chiến 5v5 chiến thuật kinh điển, nơi 10 người chơi chia hai phe: Black List và Global Risk. Một đội đặt bom và tấn công; đội còn lại phòng thủ và gỡ bom. Chiến lược, độ chính xác và phối hợp đồng đội quyết định thắng thua.

Chế Độ Team Deathmatch
Chế độ đấu đội căng từng giây, nóng từng nhịp. Hồi sinh chớp nhoáng, giao tranh không ngừng, từng giây từng phút đều quyết định thắng bại. Thử thách phản xạ, khẳng định bản lĩnh và làm chủ chiến trường!

data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Cash GO!

Arrow Cash GO is a fast-paced, addictive puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by tapping on directional markers to remove them. Every successful tap earns you in-game cash, which you can accumulate and eventually withdraw as real money!

How to Play

The game presents you with a board filled with multiple lines, each marked with a direction indicator pointing either horizontally or vertically. Your task is to tap on these indicators to make the lines slide out of the board in the direction they point.

However, it's not as simple as it sounds! Lines can block each other. If the path a line needs to take is blocked by another line, it gets "stuck." A line can be blocked up to three times—if it gets blocked three times, the level is failed. You'll need to think strategically about which markers to tap first to clear the board successfully.


Earn & Withdraw Real Cash

Every time you successfully tap and clear a marker, you earn in-game bills. The more levels you complete, the more bills you collect! These bills can be exchanged for real cash withdrawals.

How to Withdraw:

Accumulate enough in-game bills to meet the minimum withdrawal threshold.

Navigate to the wallet or cash-out section within the app.

Select your preferred withdrawal method and follow the instructions to transfer your earnings to your account.

It's that simple—play, earn, and cash out!

Easy to learn, hard to master – Simple tap mechanics with increasingly challenging puzzles.

Earn real money – Every tap brings you closer to a real cash payout.

100% free to play – No upfront costs, just pure gaming fun.

data.name: Pawdoku
data.description_full:
Find every friend their place. Clear the board. Pure logic, pure calm. ✨
Pawdoku is a clean, minimalist Queens-style logic puzzle built around a simple promise: every puzzle has exactly one correct answer, and you can always reach it through pure deduction. Place one piece in each row, each column, and each colored region — and make sure no two pieces ever touch, not even diagonally. The moment you place the last piece, you'll know you earned it.
✓ No timer. ✓ No pressure. ✓ Play offline anywhere.

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE PAWDOKU
• A calm, single-solution logic puzzle that rewards reasoning over guessing
• Hints that teach, not spoil — they show the next logical step and why it holds
• Boards that grow with you, from a cozy 4×4 all the way to a deep 10×10
• Smooth, tactile placement and a satisfying final-placement moment every level
• Works fully offline with fast loading and a clean, distraction-free interface

🧩 HOW TO PLAY
• Place exactly one piece in every row, every column, and every colored region
• Keep pieces apart — no two may sit adjacent, not even diagonally
• Use deduction, not luck — every puzzle has one guaranteed answer
• Tap a hint to highlight the next logical step when the grid feels tight
• Fill the board correctly to solve the puzzle and unlock the next size

🎯 WHY THIS PUZZLE STANDS OUT
• Simple rules, deep strategy, and a truly mindful logic escape
• One board, one solution — no guessing, no dead ends, no luck
• Hints that build understanding, so you learn how you actually solved it
• Perfect for short breaks or longer sessions to ease stress and sharpen focus
• Clean visuals and gentle pacing that keep every puzzle readable

🧠 A LOGIC PUZZLE FOR ANY MOMENT
Learn the rules in seconds, then master trickier region shapes and configurations across dozens of clever boards. Start small on 4×4, then work up through 5×5, 6×6, all the way to 10×10. The rules never change — the depth just keeps unfolding. If you love Sudoku but want something fresh, or you've tried Queens puzzles and want one that meets you at your level, this is it.
Whether you have one minute or one hour, Pawdoku fits your pace. No clock racing against you, no pressure to rush — just you, the board, and the quiet satisfaction of a perfectly solved puzzle.
Download Pawdoku now. Place every piece, trust your logic, and find calm in the one right answer — anywhere, anytime. 🎯

data.name: Majestic Mahjong
data.description_full:
Majestic Mahjong – Match Tiles & Collect Characters
In a forgotten world of tile layouts, every Mahjong tile is not just a symbol—but a fragment of dormant memory.
The moment you begin moving them, the story starts to reassemble itself.

■ This is not a typical match game
Majestic Mahjong reimagines classic Mahjong triple-match gameplay as a spatial puzzle ritual.
You are not simply clearing tiles—you are reorganizing a collapsing and reforming structure of memory.
Every successful match of three identical tiles triggers chain reactions—paths open, structures shift, and new possibilities emerge.

■ Core Gameplay
Search for connectable tiles within layered structures
Match three identical tiles to clear them
Continuously adjust paths within limited space
Clear the entire board to progress through levels
The rules are simple—but every stage forces you to think differently.

■ Character Collection System
Beyond the board lies a group of “witnesses of memory.”
As you progress, you will gradually unlock and collect new characters. They do not all appear at once, but join your journey step by step.
When you achieve milestone breakthroughs and clear key structures, these characters will appear and offer brief but genuine encouragement at moments of victory—confirming your choices and acknowledging your persistence.
As you continue forward, more companions will be added to your collection. They are not just entries in a gallery, but fellow travelers in your unfolding journey.
You are not merely collecting characters—you are building a growing network of companionship and memory.

■ No Repeated Levels
There is no concept of repetitive grinding.
Every board is a newly formed structural puzzle:
Maze-like blocked paths
Collapsing tower-like layers
Compressed fragments of memory
Each entry presents a new order to decipher.

■ Why it’s addictive
Not because it is simple—but because you always feel:
“One more round, and I can find a better solution.”
And eventually, you do.
More importantly, you are not alone.
You are not clearing puzzles by yourself—you are gradually meeting companions, together restoring order to a fragmented world of tiles.

■ Who it’s for
Players who enjoy light strategy puzzles
Players who enjoy character collection and progression
Players who want short, relaxing but engaging sessions
And anyone who enjoys finding order in chaos

data.name: Crackface: Guess the Character
data.description_full:
Crackface turns any table into a secret-character showdown for 2–4 players. Everyone secretly picks a character. Then you take turns asking yes/no questions — "Does your character wear a hat?" — and cross suspects off the board until just one is left. Be the first to call your opponent's character by name, and the case is closed.

No ten-minute rulebook. Swipe through three cards and you're playing.

It's the classic face-guessing game you grew up with — rebuilt for 2 to 4 players, three ways to play, and characters of your own.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Pass & Play — one phone for the whole table. Make your pick, hide it, hand it over.
• No-Pass — everyone on their own phone in the same room. Hand the phone over once at the start to set your secret pick, then play with no more passing.
• Online — host a room, give friends a 6-character code or QR, and everyone plays from their own phone.

TWO MATCH MODES
• Blitz — the first correct call wins. Fast, tense, one shot.
• Classic — everyone gets to answer; the winner is whoever needed the fewest turns (and the least time on a tie).

THEMED PACKS FOR EVERY TABLE
Start with animals, dinosaurs, sea life, professions, world mythology, mythical creatures, space, aliens, cyberpunk, the wild west, sweets and fast food — and plenty more. Some packs are free from the start; the rest unlock as an optional set.

BUILD YOUR OWN BOARD
The best packs are the ones you make yourself. Pull photos from your gallery or snap them on the camera and turn anything you love into the game — original characters, inside jokes, and the people who want to be on the board. Share a finished pack with other players as a single file.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• 2 to 4 players, easy to teach
• Plays in minutes — perfect for a coffee break, a road trip, a party, or breaking the ice
• Pick your board size and a turn timer to set the pace
• Track your stats: games played, fastest win, favourite packs
• Localized in 15 languages

Pick a face. Ask the right questions. Crack it before they crack yours.

data.name: Find the Way!
data.description_full:
Overwhelmed by scattered daily distractions and looking for rush-free leisure time?

Arrow Clear is a minimalist arrow puzzle for all ages, playable with zero puzzle experience.
With clean visuals and progressive logic levels, this game steps away from intense timed races. Observe arrow layouts, determine tapping sequences and clear grids with soft taps to block outside distractions and enjoy peaceful focus.

🧩 Delightful Arrow Escape Gameplay
Colorful arrows interlace on grids and only move along their pointing directions, blocking each other's paths. You need to examine the whole layout and predict blocking relations to find proper tapping sequences. Difficulty rises smoothly: simple grids for quick relaxation, intertwined arrows to train spatial vision, geometric levels for multi-step planning. You will feel soothing satisfaction as messy grids gradually clear up and ease daily weariness.

🎨 Distraction-free Immersive Audio & Visuals
Soft matte backgrounds match vivid arrows, with no flashy effects or pop-ups. Gentle colors reduce eye strain during extended play sessions. Mellow soundtrack and subtle haptic feedback are available, and you can toggle audio and vibration freely to customize your gaming vibe.

🧘 Handy In-game Assistance Tools
No full restart needed when stuck. Practical aids support you gently without ruining puzzle fun:
• 💡 Hint: Highlight arrows ready to exit to simplify your next move
• 🧽 Eraser: Remove single blocking arrows to adjust solving plans
• 🪄 Magic Wand: Trigger chain clearing to eliminate multiple unobstructed arrows
• 📏 Full Grid Zoom: View the whole board to check all exit paths clearly

✨ Core Game Highlights
• Flexible leisure gameplay: No timers or penalties, pause and resume anytime
• Carefully crafted levels: Varied grids and geometric shapes for diverse puzzle fun
• Offline support: Play without Wi-Fi during spare moments
• Low-interruption interface: Few pop-ups for continuous immersive play
• Gentle brain training: Improve spatial awareness and sequential planning casually
• Short-session friendly: Compact levels fit all small daily gaps

🌌 Balanced Experience of Relaxation & Thinking
Many casual games are either repetitive or overly challenging. This game strikes a balanced approach between relaxation and light thinking. Sorting arrow paths calms messy thoughts. It is perfect for killing spare time, easing stress or light daily brain exercise. Plan each tap carefully and enjoy stress-free puzzle fun.

Download Arrow Clear and start your gentle relaxing puzzle journey.

data.name: Zolaesque Palladium Gal
data.description_full:
"## Gameplay

- **Objective**: In each level, you must successfully guide the laser beam emitted by the Emitter to the target Receiver and reflect it through a series of mirrors.
- **Controls**:
- **Rotate Mirror**: Click and drag a mirror to rotate it 360 degrees, changing the angle of the laser's reflection.
- **Move Mirror**: In some levels, the mirror can be dragged to different positions.
- **Challenge Elements**:
- **Obstacles**: The laser cannot penetrate these obstacles, so you must navigate around them.
- **Time Limit**: Each level has a countdown, and you must complete it within the allotted time. The remaining time counts towards your score.

## Core Features

- **15 Carefully Designed Levels**: From easy beginners to challenging mazes, the difficulty increases gradually.
- **High Score Leaderboard**: Compete with your friends! Your score is calculated based on the levels you complete and the time remaining, and is recorded on the local leaderboard. - **Customizable Themes**: Multiple visual themes are available (e.g., blue, green, and orange), which players can switch between in the settings to suit their preferences.
- **Immersive Sound Effects**: A variety of built-in sound effects enhance the game's responsiveness and immersion.
- **Intuitive User Interface**: A simple and beautiful floating user interface provides a smooth gaming experience."
data.description_short: A puzzle Android game that tests logic and spatial imagination

data.name: Paint Hide and Seek: Online
data.description_full:
Paint Hide And Seek: Online is an online party game where you paint yourself, blend into the background, and try to survive until the end.

Create a private room, share the room code, or jump into matchmaking and play with other people online. Play with up to 8 players in the same room.

Voice chat makes every round chaotic, funny, and full of suspicion. Accuse your friends, fake your location, laugh when someone walks past you, and celebrate when your camouflage actually works.

HOW TO PLAY

You have 180 seconds to find the perfect hiding spot.

Run around the map, choose a wall, object, floor, corner, or weird little place, then paint yourself to match the background. The better you blend in, the harder it is for everyone to find you.

When hiding time ends, everyone starts seeking at the same time. Look carefully, trust your eyes, and try to spot the hidden players before they survive.

The last hidden player wins the round.

PAINT, BLEND, HIDE, SEEK

Paint Hide And Seek: Online combines colorful hide-and-seek gameplay with creative camouflage mechanics.

Instead of only hiding behind objects, you become part of the scene. Paint your character, match the colors around you, and blend into the background.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE PAINT HIDE AND SEEK: ONLINE

Online rooms for up to 8 players

Private room codes to play with friends

Matchmaking with other players

Voice chat for funny social gameplay

180 seconds to hide and paint yourself

Everyone seeks at the same time

Last hidden player wins

Colorful maps and sneaky hiding spots

Easy to learn, hard to master

Every round is different. One player may hide as a painted corner. Another may become almost invisible on a wall. Someone may stand in plain sight and still survive.

Paint yourself. Blend in. Trick your friends. Find the hidden players.

Play Paint Hide And Seek: Online now and start the ultimate online hide-and-seek battle.

Word Bubble Associations is a sorting puzzle where you connect and sort terms, match associations, combine bubbles, and find hidden connections.

Find words that belong to one topic. Connect and combine the correct ones into groups, then reveal the category name. When four items are found correctly, the category disappears, and you continue searching on the field to train logic, memory, brain and the mind.

Here it is important to understand which items can be grouped by association or hidden logic. Put them together by meaning, find the correct category, and clear the entire field. This word bubble association challenge is also a bubble merge puzzle, where every correct choice helps you move forward.

WHY YOU WILL LIKE IT

• Interesting. Every level is a new puzzle with fresh groups and hidden links.
• Useful. The app helps develop memory, attention, and vocabulary.
• Smart. This is a logic challenge where you need to think, compare, and search for associations.
• Simple. Connect items, reveal categories, and complete levels.
• Free. Download, play, and train your mind at a comfortable pace.
• Calm. This calm experience is great for players who enjoy calming games and relaxed thinking.

WHO IT IS FOR

Find more complex connections, use mnemonic associations, and complete levels faster. Fans of puzzle brain games, memory games, vocabulary games, assorted puzzle games, and word chain challenges can enjoy a calm but thoughtful experience.

CONTENT AND MECHANICS

• Word sorting: sort items, search for connections, and divide them into categories.
• Word bubble association: find the common idea and connect suitable bubbles.
• Connect into groups: four items form one category.
• Word search: find items that fit each other.
• Matching and logic: use matching skills to compare ideas and choose the right group.
• Brain training: develop attention, memory, and logical thinking.

This is not a classic crossword, word search, or unscramble words. It is a puzzle for those who love to think, match, connect, and sort.

data.name: 3D Bubble Pop：Relaxing ASMR
data.description_full:
🦦 Game Overview
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a stress-relieving gift brought to you by a perpetually chill capybara.
In this fresh take on the classic bubble shooter, there is only one thing to do: aim, shoot, and pop. The slightly tilted 3D perspective makes the trajectory of every bubble clearly visible. As colorful bubbles collide and burst in mid-air, you’re treated to more than just a rising score; finely tuned ASMR sound effects provide a dual relaxation experience for both your fingertips and your ears.
No complex storylines or maps to unlock here—just a capybara hanging out with you, a pristine 3D bubble world, and a journey of popping bubbles that lets your mind completely unwind.

---
🎮 Gameplay
Core Rules: Match colors to pop groups of three.
The rules are simple, though the shooting angle requires a bit of thought.
- Shoot Bubbles: A colored bubble is loaded into the launcher at the bottom of the screen. Aim at the cluster of bubbles above and fire.
- Clear Bubbles: When your shot connects with a group of three or more bubbles of the same color, that group pops and falls away.
- Clear the Level: Eliminate all the suspended bubbles to advance to the next level.
Strategy & Tips
- Use Ricochets: Bubbles bounce off the side walls. If a direct path is blocked, use the walls to bank your shot—this requires a little quick mental geometry.
- Watch for Gravity: When a group pops, unsupported bubbles will fall due to gravity; these falling bubbles count toward your score too. Targeting key support points first can trigger a satisfying chain reaction of falling bubbles. ---
🎨 Clean 3D Visuals
- Slightly Tilted Perspective: The game employs a slightly tilted 3D view, allowing you to clearly see the depth and layering of the stacked bubbles without making aiming difficult due to an extreme angle. This design preserves the classic bubble-shooter field of view while adding a sense of realistic spatial depth.
- Minimalist Background: There are no complex theme changes; the game features a single, soft, gradient background with a frosted-glass texture. All visual elements serve the gameplay—free of superfluous decorations—letting you focus entirely on the joy of shooting.
- Bubble Texture: Each bubble boasts a translucent, glossy sheen with light playing across its surface, accompanied by subtle expansion and contraction animations upon impact.
🧘 Stress-Free, Pure Gameplay
- No Time Limits: No countdown timers rush you through levels; take your time adjusting your aim to find the perfect shot trajectory.
- No Forced Tasks: There are no daily missions to complete, nor stars or keys to collect. Simply open the game, start popping, and pick it up or put it down whenever you like.

---
✅ Summary
"Aim, shoot, and listen to the bubbles pop. Let the Capybara keep you company during a gentle, leisurely break."
*3D Bubble Pop: Relaxing ASMR* is a bubble-shooting game that returns to the classics with a focus on stress relief. It strips away complex progression and collection systems, leaving only the core fun of aiming, bouncing, and popping. Exquisite ASMR-quality sound effects, a calm Capybara companion, and clean 3D visuals combine to create a tranquil space where you can relax your mind anytime, anywhere.
Whether you are a veteran bubble-shooter player or simply looking for a way to unwind and find some peace, you’ll find your own rhythm here.
Open the game, adjust your angle, and join the Capybara in watching the bubbles bloom in the air.

We hope you enjoy the game! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.
data.description_short: Experience the thrill and precision of 3D bubble popping!

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

• Match each bus with the same color sand
• Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
• Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
• Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
• Relaxing color-matching gameplay
• Clever bus parking jam puzzles
• Satisfying sand-clearing effects

Every level is a small logic challenge. A bus may look ready to move, but its route might block another vehicle. A color may be visible, but the sand below it must be cleared first. Think ahead, follow the arrows, and find the perfect order to clear the whole sandfall.
If you enjoy bus games, parking jam puzzles, color sort games, traffic escape challenges, or relaxing logic games, Jam Bus: Sandfall gives you a colorful new puzzle to solve.

data.name: Fruit Fortune
data.description_full:
⏱️ Race against the clock, match vibrant fruit icons across a 3x3 grid, and maximize your score in action-packed 60-second puzzle sessions!

Welcome to Fruit Fortune, a bright and fast-paced single-player arcade matching game designed for quick, engaging breaks. Your main goal is simple but challenging: activate the grid, align matching fruits along the active central row, and accumulate as many game coins as possible before the 60-second timer hits zero. Test your speed, track your performance, and try to outdo your personal best with every run!

🎮 How to Play:
• Start the Countdown: Every round lasts exactly 60 seconds, making each session a thrilling race for a high score.

• Spin and Match: Tap the "Play" button to set the 3x3 fruit matrix into motion with fluid, clean animations.

• Check the Center Line: Only the central horizontal row is active for scoring. Watch closely as the items come to a stop!

• Earn Virtual Rewards: Aligning matching fruits triggers an instant points drop. Finding two identical items grants a standard reward, while matching three identical fruits delivers a massive score boost. Rarer tropical fruits yield significantly higher coin values!

⚡ Game Features:
• Polished Local High-Score Board: Monitor your progress effortlessly! The game automatically saves your final score after each session and displays:

- Your most recent round result.

- Your all-time personal best record.

- A detailed history log of your top attempts, complete with exact dates and timestamps.

data.name: Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle, the relaxing sorting game where colorful nuts are scattered across screws, and it’s up to you to bring order. Your goal is simple: move the nuts one by one until every screw holds a perfect stack of a single color. No timers. No rush. Just the calm satisfaction of watching messy piles transform into neat, matching towers.
Game Features:
- Sort, Stack, and Solve
Each level gives you a set of screws loaded with mixed-up colorful nuts. Pick up the top nut from any screw and place it onto another — but only if the colors match or the screw is empty. It’s easy to pick up, yet every move asks you to plan ahead.
- A Fresh Twist on Classic Sorting
If you love water sort or ball sort puzzles, you’ll feel right at home. Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle takes that familiar, deeply satisfying sorting loop and gives it a tactile new feel — Stacking nuts onto screws feels crisp, chunky, and impossibly satisfying.
- Relax at Your Own Pace
There are no clocks, no countdowns, and no fail states. Take as much time as you need. Undo a move, rethink your strategy, and enjoy the soothing rhythm of sorting. This is a puzzle game designed to calm your mind, not test your nerves.
- From Simple to Clever
Early levels are gentle and welcoming, with just a few colors and plenty of room to move. As you progress, more screws, more nuts, and tighter arrangements appear — turning each puzzle into a quietly rewarding brain teaser that keeps you engaged without ever feeling unfair.
- Satisfying Every Time
When the last nut clicks into place and a messy screw becomes a flawless single-color stack, the moment is pure satisfaction. Smooth animations and gentle sound effects make every completion feel like a small victory.
Why You’ll Love Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle:
- If you love sorting, organizing, and tidying things up, this game was made for you.
- If you enjoy puzzle games that let you play at your own speed — on the couch, on a break, or winding down at night — you’ll feel right at home.
- If you’re looking for a distraction-free game that keeps your mind quietly engaged without stress, this is it.
- If you find joy in watching scattered pieces come together into perfect order, you’ll keep coming back for more.
Download Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle today and start sorting the nuts, one move at a time.
